definition_zh: 熟人；认识；了解；泛泛之交
definition_en: a person one knows slightly but not closely, or the state of knowing someone or something
core_image: 在聚会上交换过姓名，却还没熟到能聊家常的那个人
scene: 婚礼的签到处，来宾彼此点头微笑。She met several old acquaintances at the reunion but remembered few names.
sceneCN: 这里 acquaintance 是「熟人」（第 1 个义项：认识但并不亲密的人）；句意为她在聚会上遇到几位老熟人，却记不清几个名字。

pos.zh: 名词：熟人；认识；了解；泛泛之交

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀 -ance 得到的动词，义为「使认识；使熟悉」
由动词加 -ed 构成，义为「熟悉的；认识的」
由本词加名词后缀 -ship 构成，义为「交往关系；相识关系」

senses.title: A person one knows
senses.definition: a person whom one knows, but usually not as a close friend
senses.definitionCN: 自己认识的人，但通常不算亲密朋友
senses.example: He is an acquaintance from my university days.
senses.exampleCN: 他是我大学时期认识的人。
senses.why: The core image is exchanging names at a party: a face and a name are now stored, though the story is not.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是在聚会上交换姓名：面孔和名字被记下了，故事却还没有。

senses.title: A slight acquaintance, not a close friend
senses.definition: a person one knows only slightly, with no deep or regular contact
senses.definitionCN: 只是略微认识、没有深厚或经常往来的人
senses.example: We are casual acquaintances rather than friends.
senses.exampleCN: 我们只是泛泛之交，算不上朋友。
senses.why: The name was exchanged once and never deepened, so the tie stays thin.
senses.whyCN: 名字只交换过一次，从未加深，所以这层关系始终很薄。

senses.title: The state of knowing someone
senses.definition: the state or fact of knowing someone, rather than the person known
senses.definitionCN: 指认识某人这一状态或事实，而不是指被认识的那个人
senses.example: Their acquaintance began at a language class.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的相识始于一个语言班。
senses.why: The abstract noun names the thin thread itself, not the person at the other end of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个抽象名词命名的是细线本身，而不是线另一端的那个人。

senses.title: Knowledge of a field
senses.definition: a limited or working knowledge of a subject, field or body of facts
senses.definitionCN: 对某一学科、领域或事实体系的有限了解或可用了解
senses.example: She has some acquaintance with medieval history.
senses.exampleCN: 她对中世纪历史有一些了解。
senses.why: Knowing a person slightly and knowing a subject slightly use the same thin thread of contact.
senses.whyCN: 略微认识一个人与略微了解一门学问，用的是同一条浅浅的接触线。

senses.title: The act of first meeting
senses.definition: in make acquaintance with, the act of first meeting someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 用于 make acquaintance with，指初次与某人或某物结识
senses.example: I made the acquaintance of the author at a book fair.
senses.exampleCN: 我在一次书展上结识了这位作者。
senses.why: The first handshake is the moment the thread is formed, which is why the phrase uses make.
senses.whyCN: 第一次握手正是细线形成的时刻，所以这个短语用 make。

senses.title: Brief contact: a passing acquaintance
senses.definition: in a passing acquaintance, a person or thing known only through a brief contact
senses.definitionCN: 用于 a passing acquaintance，指仅通过短暂接触而认识的人或事物
senses.example: The taxi driver was only a passing acquaintance.
senses.exampleCN: 那位出租车司机只是我的一面之交。
senses.why: The thread was touched once and then dropped, so the contact passes away quickly.
senses.whyCN: 细线只被碰过一次就被放下，因此这种接触很快消逝。

senses.title: One's circle of acquaintances
senses.definition: the whole group of people that one knows, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 把一个人所认识的人合在一起看时的整体
senses.example: Her acquaintances are spread across three countries.
senses.exampleCN: 她的熟人分散在三个国家。
senses.why: Many thin threads together form a net, and that net is the social circle.
senses.whyCN: 许多细线合在一起织成一张网，这张网就是交际圈。

senses.title: The mutual relation: acquaintanceship
senses.definition: in acquaintanceship, the relation between two people who know each other slightly
senses.definitionCN: 用于 acquaintanceship，指两个略有认识的人之间的关系
senses.example: Their acquaintanceship never grew into friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的交往关系始终没有发展成友谊。
senses.why: The suffix -ship names the relation between two ends of the same thread.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ship 命名的正是同一条细线两端之间的关系。

intro.en: Acquaintance came from Old French, and its root is the Latin verb for getting to know.
intro.cn: acquaintance 来自古法语，其词根是拉丁语中表示「开始认识」的动词。

items.en: cognoscere meant 'to get to know, recognize', built on co- and gnoscere 'to know'.
items.cn: cognoscere 意为「开始认识、认出」，由 co- 与 gnoscere「知道」构成。

items.en: Late Latin accognitare, from ad- plus cognoscere, meant 'to make known'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 accognitare 由 ad- 加 cognoscere 构成，义为「使认识」。

items.en: Old French acointier meant 'to make acquainted, bring into contact'.
items.cn: 古法语 acointier 意为「使认识、使接触」。

items.en: The noun acointance meant 'acquaintance, familiarity'; English borrowed it in the fourteenth century, though the exact date is uncertain.
items.cn: 名词 acointance 意为「相识、熟悉」；英语在十四世纪借入，确切年代不确定。

items.en: The noun kept both the person sense and the knowledge sense.

entries.definition: The verb meaning to make someone familiar with something or someone.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使认识、使熟悉」，是本词的基础动词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning familiar with someone or something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「熟悉的、认识的」，由动词加 -ed 构成。

entries.definition: The noun for the relation between acquaintances.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交往关系」，由本词加 -ship 构成。

entries.definition: A formal adjective meaning aware of something, from the same Latin knowing root.
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语，形容词，义为「知晓的」，与本词同出拉丁语「知道」词根。

entries.definition: A person one knows who can be useful, or the state of having met.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「熟人、人脉」，也可指有过接触的状态。

entries.definition: A person connected with another through work or activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「同事、伙伴」，指因工作或活动而有联系的人。

entries.definition: A person one knows well and likes, closer than an acquaintance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「朋友」，指熟识并喜欢的人，比 acquaintance 更亲近。

entries.definition: A person one works with, often known only in a professional setting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「同事」，常常只在工作场合认识。

entries.definition: The state of knowing something well, the abstract counterpart of the knowledge sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「熟悉」，是「了解」义项对应的抽象说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old French verb and the fixed phrases acquaintance appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的古法语动词，以及 acquaintance 实际出现的固定短语。

normal.en: acointier is to make acquainted, and acointance is the resulting acquaintance.
normal.cn: acointier 是「使认识」，acointance 就是由此产生的「相识」。

normal.en: make acquaintance with marks the first handshake that forms the thread.
normal.cn: 「make acquaintance with」标记的是形成细线的第一次握手。

normal.en: a passing acquaintance is a thread touched once and dropped.
normal.cn: 「a passing acquaintance」是一根只碰过一次就被放下的细线。

normal.en: acquaintanceship adds -ship to name the relation itself.
normal.cn: acquaintanceship 加 -ship，命名的是关系本身。

normal.en: acquainted with a subject is the knowledge sense applied to study.
normal.cn: 「acquainted with a subject」是把「了解」义项用在学问上。

abstract.en: Picture a party where names are exchanged but no stories are: that thin line is an acquaintance.
abstract.cn: 想象一个聚会上只交换姓名、不讲故事：那条细细的线就是 acquaintance。

abstract.en: Many such thin lines together become a wide net of acquaintances.
abstract.cn: 许多这样的细线合在一起，就成了熟人织成的宽网。

abstract.en: The same word covers knowing a person and knowing a subject, because both are shallow contact.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指认识一个人，也指了解一门学问，因为两者都是浅浅的接触。

examples.en: He is an old acquaintance from my university days.
examples.cn: 他是我大学时期的一位老熟人。

examples.en: I made the acquaintance of the author at a book fair.
examples.cn: 我在一次书展上结识了这位作者。

examples.en: Her acquaintance with the subject is only superficial.
examples.cn: 她对这门学科的了解只是表面的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿夸因腾斯」——阿夸在聚会上认了个人，只算熟人

root: 古法语 acointance 来自 acointier「使认识」，上溯晚期拉丁语 accognitare（ad- 加 cognoscere「认识」），与 know 类词同属印欧语「知道」词根。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of acquaintance all describe a thin thread of contact: a known person, a slight acquaintance, the state of knowing, knowledge of a field, a first meeting, passing contact, a social circle, and the acquaintanceship itself.
sensesIntro.cn: acquaintance 的八个义项都在描述一条浅浅的接触线：认识的人、泛泛之交、相识状态、对领域的了解、初次结识、一面之交、交际圈，以及交往关系本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people exchange names at a party, and a thin thread forms between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人在聚会上交换姓名，之间形成一条细细的线。

branches.en: THE PERSON: the one at the other end of the thread may be a known person or only a slight acquaintance.
branches.cn: 人线：线另一端的人，可以是认识的人，也可能只是泛泛之交。

branches.en: THE RELATION: the noun can name the state of knowing or the relation between two people.
branches.cn: 关系线：这个名词可以命名相识状态，也可以命名两个人之间的关系。

branches.en: THE SUBJECT: the same shallow contact is applied to knowledge of a field.
branches.cn: 学问线：同一种浅浅的接触也被用在某个领域的了解上。

branches.en: THE MOMENT: the thread is formed at a first meeting and passes quickly when contact is brief.
branches.cn: 时刻线：细线在初次结识时形成，接触短暂时又会很快消逝。

branches.en: THE NET: many thin threads together become a circle of acquaintances.
branches.cn: 网络线：许多细线合在一起，就成了熟人的圈子。

definition_zh: 获得；取得；学到；养成；染上
definition_en: to obtain something, gain a skill or habit, or come to have a quality, illness or reputation
core_image: 伸手把货架上的东西取下来，放进自己的篮子
scene: 旧书市场里，摊主从纸箱底翻出一本旧词典。Over the years he acquired a rare collection of first editions.
sceneCN: 这里 acquire 是「获得、收集到」（第 1 个义项：通过努力或时间取得某物）；句意为多年来他收集到一批珍稀初版书。

pos.zh: 动词：获得；取得；学到；养成；染上

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁名词 acquisitio 构成，义为「获得；收购」，与本词同源
由拉丁词干加 -itive 构成，义为「贪得的；渴望获得的」
由本词加施动后缀 -er 构成，义为「收购方；获得者」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「后天获得的」

senses.title: To obtain an object
senses.definition: to get an object into one's possession, often through effort or time
senses.definitionCN: 把某件物品弄到自己手中，常指经过努力或时间
senses.example: He acquired the painting after years of searching.
senses.exampleCN: 寻找多年之后，他得到了那幅画。
senses.why: The core image is a hand reaching out to take something down from a shelf.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一只手伸出去，把货架上的东西取下来。

senses.title: To purchase
senses.definition: to buy something, especially something valuable or significant
senses.definitionCN: 买下某物，尤指有价值或重要的东西
senses.example: The museum acquired the letters at auction.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆在拍卖会上购得了那批书信。
senses.why: Taking from the shelf can also mean paying for it, so the hand becomes a buyer's hand.
senses.whyCN: 从货架上取走也可以意味着付钱买下，于是那只手成了买家的手。

senses.title: To learn a skill
senses.definition: to gain a skill or ability through practice or study
senses.definitionCN: 通过练习或学习获得某项技能或能力
senses.example: She acquired a working knowledge of Spanish in two years.
senses.exampleCN: 她两年内学到了可用的西班牙语。
senses.why: A skill is taken into the mind as a tool is taken into the basket.
senses.whyCN: 技能被收入脑中，正如工具被收进篮子。

senses.title: To develop a habit
senses.definition: to come to have a habit or manner of behaviour over time
senses.definitionCN: 随着时间逐渐形成某种习惯或行为方式
senses.example: He acquired the habit of reading before breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 他养成了早饭前读书的习惯。
senses.why: Repeated taking turns into a settled habit, which is also something one comes to have.
senses.whyCN: 反复的取用会变成稳定的习惯，而习惯同样是逐渐「有」的东西。

senses.title: To contract an illness
senses.definition: to come to have a disease or medical condition
senses.definitionCN: 患上某种疾病或出现某种病症
senses.example: The travellers acquired a fever in the lowlands.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行者在低地染上了热病。
senses.why: The illness is picked up from outside, as an object is picked up from a shelf.
senses.whyCN: 疾病是从外部「拿」来的，正如物品是从货架上取下的。

senses.title: To gain a reputation
senses.definition: to come to be known for a quality, often through one's actions
senses.definitionCN: 因某种品质或行为而逐渐为人所知
senses.example: The firm acquired a reputation for fair dealing.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司取得了公平交易的好名声。
senses.why: A reputation is something others hand to you, though it settles as if you had taken it.
senses.whyCN: 声誉是别人交给你的东西，但它落定之后，仿佛是你自己取来的。

senses.title: To take over a company
senses.definition: in business, to buy or take control of another company
senses.definitionCN: 在商业中买下或取得对另一家公司的控制权
senses.example: The group acquired three smaller rivals last year.
senses.exampleCN: 该集团去年收购了三家较小的竞争对手。
senses.why: The hand now reaches for a whole business, and the basket holds companies.
senses.whyCN: 这只手现在伸向一整家企业，篮子里装的是公司。

senses.title: To develop a taste
senses.definition: in acquire a taste for, to come to like something through repeated exposure
senses.definitionCN: 用于 acquire a taste for，指通过反复接触逐渐喜欢上某物
senses.example: She acquired a taste for strong coffee while living abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 旅居国外时，她培养出了喝浓咖啡的爱好。
senses.why: Liking is taken in slowly, like a new food moved from the shelf into daily use.
senses.whyCN: 喜好是慢慢被收入生活的，就像一种新食物从货架进入日常。

intro.en: Acquire is built from a Latin verb meaning to seek and a Latin prefix meaning to or toward.
intro.cn: acquire 由拉丁语中表示「寻求」的动词与表示「向」的前缀构成。

items.en: quaerere meant 'to seek, search for'; its deeper Indo-European origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: quaerere 意为「寻求、搜寻」；它更早的印欧语来源不确定。

items.en: ad- 'to' plus quaerere formed acquirere, 'to get for oneself, obtain in addition'.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 quaerere 构成 acquirere，义为「为自己求得、额外获得」。

items.en: The noun acquisitio 'acquisition' was built on the participle acquisitus.
items.cn: 名词 acquisitio「获得」建立在分词 acquisitus 之上。

items.en: Old French aquerre carried the verb into English; the exact date of borrowing is uncertain.
items.cn: 古法语 aquerre 把这个动词带入英语；确切的借入年代不确定。

items.en: The spelling settled as acquire, and the business sense 'take over a company' is modern.
items.cn: 拼写最终固定为 acquire，「收购公司」的商业义项是现代发展出来的。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same Latin verb for seeking; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of getting something.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁「寻求」动词构成的词；近义组收表示「取得某物」的动词。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「获得、收购物」，来自拉丁语 acquisitio。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning eager to acquire things.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「贪得的、渴望获得的」，同出 quaerere 词根。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「收购方、获得者」，由本词加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to need or demand, from re- plus quaerere.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「需要、要求」，由 re- 加 quaerere 构成，与 acquire 同根。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to ask or search for information, from in- plus quaerere.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「询问、查究」，由 in- 加 quaerere 构成，与 acquire 同根。

entries.definition: A formal verb meaning to get something, often through effort.
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语，动词，义为「获得」，常指经过努力。

entries.definition: To get something useful or valuable, such as time, weight or trust.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「赢得、增加」，常指获得时间、体重或信任等有用的东西。

entries.definition: The general everyday verb for obtaining something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「得到」，是最日常、最一般的说法。

entries.definition: A formal verb meaning to obtain something with care or effort.
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语，动词，义为「设法取得」，强调用心或费力。

entries.definition: To reach or achieve something after effort, often a level or goal.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「达到、获得」，常指经过努力达到某水平或目标。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb for seeking and the phrases acquire actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁语「寻求」动词，以及 acquire 实际出现的短语。

normal.en: quaerere is to seek: acquiring begins with looking for something.
normal.cn: quaerere 是「寻求」：acquire 从寻找某物开始。

normal.en: ad- plus quaerere gives acquirere, to get for oneself.
normal.cn: ad- 加 quaerere 得到 acquirere，义为「为自己求得」。

normal.en: acquisition is the noun built on the same Latin stem.
normal.cn: acquisition 是建立在同一拉丁词干上的名词。

normal.en: acquire a taste for shows how liking is slowly taken in.
normal.cn: 「acquire a taste for」展示了喜好如何被慢慢收入生活。

normal.en: acquire a company puts the whole business into the basket.
normal.cn: 「acquire a company」把整家企业放进篮子里。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching up to a shelf and pulling an object down into a basket.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸向货架，把一件东西取下来放进篮子。

abstract.en: The same gesture can take a skill, a habit, an illness or a reputation.
abstract.cn: 同一个动作可以拿走技能、习惯、疾病或声誉。

abstract.en: Seeking comes first: nothing is taken down unless the hand has looked for it.
abstract.cn: 先有寻求：除非手已经找过，否则什么也取不下来。

examples.en: She acquired a working knowledge of Spanish in two years.
examples.cn: 她两年内学到了可用的西班牙语。

examples.en: The firm acquired three smaller rivals last year.
examples.cn: 这家公司去年收购了三家较小的竞争对手。

root: 拉丁语 acquirere 由 ad-「向」加 quaerere「寻求」构成，本义是「额外求得、弄到手」；同根名词 acquisitio 生出 acquisition。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of acquire all begin with seeking and end with having: an object, a purchase, a skill, a habit, an illness, a reputation, a company, or a taste.
sensesIntro.cn: acquire 的八个义项都从「寻求」开始、以「拥有」结束：物品、购得之物、技能、习惯、疾病、声誉、公司，或一种喜好。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaches to a shelf, takes something down, and puts it into a basket.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸向货架，把东西取下，放进篮子里。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: seeking ends with an object in hand, whether found or bought.
branches.cn: 物品线：寻求以手中之物结束，不论那是寻得的还是买来的。

branches.en: THE MIND AND BODY: skills and habits are taken in through repetition.
branches.cn: 心智与身体线：技能与习惯通过重复被收入自身。

branches.en: THE UNWANTED: an illness is also picked up, though nobody seeks it.
branches.cn: 不想要的东西线：疾病同样是被「拿」来的，虽然没人寻求它。

branches.en: THE STANDING AND THE FIRM: reputation and companies are the largest things the hand can take.
branches.cn: 名望与企业线：声誉与公司是这只手能取走的最大之物。

branches.en: THE SLOW TASTE: liking is acquired by repeated exposure, not by one grab.
branches.cn: 慢品味线：喜好靠反复接触获得，而不是一把抓来。

definition_zh: 获得；购得；收购；购得物；习得
definition_en: the act of obtaining something, or the thing obtained, especially a company bought by another
core_image: 一只手把原本属于别人的东西稳稳收进自己怀里
scene: 拍卖行的槌声刚落下，那幅旧画换了主人，工作人员小心地把它包好抬上车。The museum announced the acquisition of the painting at a private auction.
sceneCN: 这里 acquisition 是「获得行为」（第 1 个义项：把某物取得并据为己有的过程）；句意为博物馆宣布在一场私人拍卖中购得了这幅画。

pos.zh: 名词：获得；购得；收购；购得物；习得

derivatives.zh: 由 acquisition 去掉名词后缀 -ition 得到动词，义为「获得；收购；学到」
由 acquire 加形容词后缀 -itive 构成，义为「贪得的；渴求获得的」，语义从「取得」偏移为「好取」
由 acquire 加施动名词后缀 -er 构成，义为「收购方；获得者」
由 acquisitive 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「贪得性；获取欲」

senses.title: The act of getting something
senses.definition: the act or process of obtaining something, especially something valuable or needed
senses.definitionCN: 取得某物的行为或过程，尤指有价值或正需要的东西
senses.example: The acquisition of the land took several months of talks.
senses.exampleCN: 取得这块土地花了几个月的谈判。
senses.why: Latin ad- means towards and quaerere means to seek; acquisition is the seeking that ends with the thing in hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ad- 表示「向」，quaerere 表示「寻求」；acquisition 就是一次以「东西到手」告终的寻求。

senses.title: The thing that has been obtained
senses.definition: something obtained, especially a valuable object added to a collection or to a company's assets
senses.definitionCN: 所取得的东西，尤指加入收藏或并入公司资产的有价值之物
senses.example: The sculpture was the gallery's most expensive acquisition.
senses.exampleCN: 那件雕塑是这家画廊最昂贵的藏品。
senses.why: The noun names not only the getting but the got: once the seeking ends, what remains is an acquisition.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词不只指「取」的动作，也指「取到的东西」：寻求结束后留下的物件本身就是一项 acquisition。

senses.title: The buying of one company by another
senses.definition: the purchase of a company, or of a controlling share in it, by another company
senses.definitionCN: 一家公司购买另一家公司或其控股股份的行为
senses.example: The bank financed the acquisition of a rival chain.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行为收购一家竞争对手连锁店提供了资金。
senses.why: Companies are things too; when one firm takes another into its hands, the old word for obtaining fits exactly.
senses.whyCN: 公司也是一种「东西」；一家企业把另一家收进手中时，旧的「取得」一词正好合用。

senses.title: The natural learning of a language
senses.definition: the gradual, largely unconscious development of a language in a person, especially a first language
senses.definitionCN: 一个人逐步、多半无意识地掌握一门语言，尤指母语
senses.example: Language acquisition begins long before a child starts school.
senses.exampleCN: 语言习得在孩子上学之前很久就开始了。
senses.why: Learning a mother tongue is not a purchase but an intake: sounds and rules are taken in until they belong to the learner.
senses.whyCN: 学会母语不是购买，而是一种吸纳：声音与规则被收进来，直到真正属于学习者。

senses.title: The gaining of a skill or habit
senses.definition: the process of gradually developing a skill, a habit or a body of knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 逐步养成一种技能、习惯或积累一门知识的过程
senses.example: The acquisition of good study habits takes patience.
senses.exampleCN: 养成好的学习习惯需要耐心。
senses.why: A skill is taken into the body and mind the same way an object is taken into the hand, one repetition at a time.
senses.whyCN: 技能被收进身体与头脑，和物件被收进手心是同一种方式，一次重复一次积累。

senses.title: The collection of data or measurements
senses.definition: the process of gathering data, images or measurements, often by an instrument or a system
senses.definitionCN: 收集数据、图像或测量值的过程，通常借助仪器或系统完成
senses.example: The satellite handles data acquisition over the polar regions.
senses.exampleCN: 这颗卫星负责极地上空的数据采集。
senses.why: Instruments obtain readings the way hands obtain objects; the word keeps the image of taking something in.
senses.whyCN: 仪器取得读数和手取得物件是同一种画面；这个词始终保留「把东西收进来」的意象。

senses.title: An addition to a library or collection
senses.definition: a new item added to a library, museum or private collection
senses.definitionCN: 新加入图书馆、博物馆或私人收藏的一件藏品
senses.example: The library listed its recent acquisitions in the newsletter.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆在通讯中列出了最近入藏的书籍。
senses.why: A collection grows by taking things in; each new item is an acquisition in the most concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 收藏靠「收进来」而增长；每一件新入藏的物品都是 acquisition 最具体的用法。

senses.title: The cost of obtaining an asset
senses.definition: in accounting, the total cost of obtaining an asset, including its price and the expenses of the purchase
senses.definitionCN: 会计上取得一项资产的全部成本，包括买价与购置过程中的费用
senses.example: The acquisition cost includes delivery and installation.
senses.exampleCN: 取得成本包括运输与安装费用。
senses.why: Every taking has a price; the word moves from the object obtained to the money paid to obtain it.
senses.whyCN: 任何一次取得都有代价；这个词从「取到的东西」转指「为取到它而付出的钱」。

intro.en: Acquisition is a Latin noun of seeking and obtaining, carried into English through French.
intro.cn: acquisition 是拉丁语中表示「寻求、取得」的名词，经由法语进入英语。

items.en: The deeper origin of Latin quaerere is source uncertain; it is generally connected with seeking and asking.
items.cn: 拉丁语 quaerere 更早的来源不确定，一般认为与「寻找、询问」有关。

items.en: quaerere meant to seek, search for or ask, and it also gave quaestio, an inquiry.
items.cn: quaerere 意为「寻求、搜寻、询问」，它还生出 quaestio「探究、问题」。

items.en: ad- meaning to plus quaerere formed acquirere, to get in addition, to acquire.
items.cn: 表示「向」的 ad- 加 quaerere 构成 acquirere，意为「额外取得、获得」。

items.en: The noun acquisitio named a getting or acquiring, and its stem acquisit- passed into French and English.
items.cn: 名词 acquisitio 指「取得、获得」，其词干 acquisit- 进入法语与英语。

items.en: English took the noun through Old French acquisicion; the business sense of buying a company came much later.
items.cn: 英语经由古法语 acquisicion 借入这个名词；「收购公司」的商业义要晚得多才出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same quaerere family of seeking words; the near-meaning group gathers other ways of obtaining, buying or taking over.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 quaerere「寻求」词族的词；近义组收表示取得、购买与接管的其他说法。

entries.definition: To obtain something or gain a skill; the plain action behind the noun acquisition.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「获得、学到」，是 acquisition 背后那个朴素的取得动作。

entries.definition: Eager to obtain things, especially possessions; the adjective shifts from obtaining to wanting to obtain.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「贪得的、渴求占有的」，语义从「取得」偏向「想取得」。

entries.definition: To need or demand something; built on the same seeking verb with the prefix re-.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「需要、要求」，由同一「寻求」动词加前缀 re- 构成。

entries.definition: To ask for information; the asking side of the same Latin verb quaerere.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「询问、打听」，取的是同一拉丁动词 quaerere 中「询问」的一面。

entries.definition: Extremely fine or delicate; literally sought out and chosen, from the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「精美的、精致的」，字面义是「被挑选出来的」，与 acquisition 同根。

entries.definition: The act of buying something, or the thing bought; money changes hands.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「购买、购得物」，强调付钱换物这一面。

entries.definition: The act of gaining control of a company by buying its shares; narrower and often hostile.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「接管、收购」，指通过购买股份取得公司控制权，范围更窄，常含敌意。

entries.definition: The official process of obtaining supplies or services for an organization.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「采购」，指机构为获得物资或服务而走的正式流程。

entries.definition: The achievement of a skill, level or goal after effort; used of learning rather than objects.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「达到、取得」，多指经过努力获得技能、水平或目标，用于学习而非物件。

entries.definition: The act of formally joining a group or taking office, or an item added to a collection.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「就任、加入」，也指收藏中新添的一件，语气正式。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin quaerere root and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 quaerere 词根，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: quaerere is to seek: acquisition is a seeking that ends with the thing in your hands.
normal.cn: quaerere 是「寻求」：acquisition 就是一次以东西到手告终的寻求。

normal.en: The same root gives require, inquire and exquisite, all about seeking or asking.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 require、inquire 与 exquisite，都与寻求或询问有关。

normal.en: Mergers and acquisitions is the fixed phrase for companies buying other companies.
normal.cn: mergers and acquisitions 是「公司收购公司」的固定说法。

normal.en: Language acquisition names learning a language naturally, without formal lessons.
normal.cn: language acquisition 指不经正式课程、自然学会一门语言的过程。

normal.en: An acquisition cost is the whole amount paid to obtain an asset, not only its price tag.
normal.cn: acquisition cost 是为取得一项资产付出的全部金额，而不只是标价。

abstract.en: Picture an open hand closing slowly over an object that lay on someone else's table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只张开的手，慢慢合拢，把别人桌上的东西收进掌心。

abstract.en: The same closing hand can hold a company, a language, a skill or a stream of data.
abstract.cn: 同一只合拢的手可以握住一家公司、一门语言、一项技能，或一串数据。

abstract.en: Acquisition is the moment the object stops being outside and starts belonging.
abstract.cn: acquisition 就是物件由「在身外」变成「属于自己」的那一刻。

examples.en: The acquisition of the old library took two years of negotiation.
examples.cn: 取得那座旧图书馆花了两年谈判。

examples.en: Their latest acquisition is a small software firm in the north.
examples.cn: 他们最近收购的是一家北方的小型软件公司。

examples.en: Children's language acquisition happens without formal instruction.
examples.cn: 儿童的语言习得无需正式教学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克维齐申」——伸手一勾，东西到手：获得、收购

root: 拉丁语 acquisitio「取得、获得」由 ad-「向」与 quaerere「寻求」构成；quaerere 的过去分词词干 acquisit- 进入法语与英语。acquire 指动作，acquisition 指过程或结果，也指被购得之物。更早的印欧来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of acquisition all describe something passing into new hands or into a mind: an act, a bought object, a company, a language, a skill, data, a collection item, or the cost of obtaining it.
sensesIntro.cn: acquisition 的八个义项都在描述某物进入新的手中或新的头脑：一次取得、一件购得物、一家公司、一门语言、一项技能、一批数据、一件藏品，以及取得它的成本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open hand closes over an object that belonged to someone else.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只张开的手合拢，握住原本属于别人的东西。

branches.en: THE HAND: seeking ends when the object is obtained and held.
branches.cn: 手线：寻求在物件被取得并握住的时刻结束。

branches.en: THE MARKET: one company buys another and adds it to itself.
branches.cn: 市场线：一家公司买下另一家，把它并入自身。

branches.en: THE MIND: a language or a skill enters the learner and stays there.
branches.cn: 头脑线：语言或技能进入学习者并留在他身上。

branches.en: THE STORE: data and collection items are gathered into one place.
branches.cn: 储藏线：数据与藏品被收集到同一处。

branches.en: THE LEDGER: the price of obtaining is counted into the asset.
branches.cn: 账本线：为取得而付出的价钱被计入这项资产。

intro.en: Acquisition is a Latin noun of seeking and obtaining; English keeps the Latin stem and adds only ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: acquisition 是拉丁语中表示「寻求、取得」的名词；英语保留拉丁词干，只加普通后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin quaerere, acquirere and acquisitio are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quaerere、acquirere 与 acquisitio 均有文献记录，只有更早的印欧语来源不确定。

items.example: The prefix points the seeking towards a goal.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「寻求」指向一个目标。

items.example: The verb supplies the search inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供词中的「搜寻」义。

items.example: The compound means bringing something in.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词意为把某物收进来。

items.example: The noun is the direct source of acquisition.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是 acquisition 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms the noun from the verb stem.
items.exampleCN: 它由动词词干构成名词。
它构成 acquisitive。
它构成 acquirer。

items.example: It forms require with the same seeking verb.
items.exampleCN: 它与同一「寻求」动词构成 require。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb from ad- plus quaerere

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ition 得到动词，义为「获得；收购」
由 acquire 加 -itive 构成，义为「贪得的；渴求获得的」
由 acquire 加 -er 构成，义为「收购方；获得者」
由 acquisitive 加 -ness 构成，义为「贪得性；获取欲」

definition_zh: 英亩；土地；田地；地产；大量（空间）
definition_en: a unit of land area, or a piece of land thought of as measured in this unit
core_image: 一人一牛一天能犁完的一块长方田
scene: 村口的界石旁，老人迈着步子丈量自家那块地，从这头走到那头。The farmer owns forty acres of wheat land beside the river.
sceneCN: 这里 acre 是「以英亩计的土地」（第 2 个义项：用英亩来计量的土地）；句意为这位农民在河边拥有四十英亩麦田。

pos.zh: 名词：英亩；土地；田地；地产

derivatives.zh: 由 acre 加名词后缀 -age 构成，义为「土地面积（以英亩计）」，语义从「一英亩」偏移为「总亩数」
由 acre 与 foot 复合，义为「英亩英尺」，指一英亩面积上一英尺深的水量

senses.title: A unit of land area
senses.definition: a unit of land area equal to about four thousand and forty-seven square metres
senses.definitionCN: 一种土地面积单位，约合四千零四十七平方米
senses.example: One acre is roughly the size of a football field.
senses.exampleCN: 一英亩大约相当于一个足球场的大小。
senses.why: The word began as the name of a field, and a field of standard size became the unit used to measure all land.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初就是「田地」的名称，而一块标准大小的田后来成了丈量所有土地的单位。

senses.title: Land measured in acres
senses.definition: a piece of land, especially farmland, considered as so many acres in size
senses.definitionCN: 一块土地，尤指农田，按英亩数来计算其大小
senses.example: They bought three acres with a small barn on it.
senses.exampleCN: 他们买下三英亩地，上面有一间小谷仓。
senses.why: Once the unit was fixed, the unit could stand for the thing measured: a field is simply so many acres.
senses.whyCN: 单位固定之后，单位就可以代指被量的东西：一块田就是若干英亩。

senses.title: Broad acres: a large estate
senses.definition: in the phrase broad acres, a large stretch of farmland or a country estate
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 broad acres，指大片农田或乡间地产
senses.example: The old family still owns broad acres in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 那个家族至今在山谷里拥有大片田地。
senses.why: Wide land is the most visible kind of wealth; the plural with broad turns the measure into a picture of estate.
senses.whyCN: 广阔的田地是最显眼的财富；复数加 broad 把度量单位变成了一幅「家业」的画面。

senses.title: Acres of space: a great deal of room
senses.definition: in informal speech, a very large amount of space or room
senses.definitionCN: 口语中夸张地表示极大量的空间或余地
senses.example: The new hall has acres of room for the audience.
senses.exampleCN: 新礼堂给观众留出了大片空间。
senses.why: A field is the image of open space, so acres of anything means more room than one could ever need.
senses.whyCN: 田地就是开阔空间的意象，因此 acres of 某物意为多到用不完的余地。

senses.title: A strip of ploughed land, an old sense
senses.titleCN: 一条犁过的条田（历史义）
senses.definition: in historical use, a narrow strip of ploughed land in an open field
senses.definitionCN: 历史用法中指开阔田地里一条狭长的犁耕地
senses.example: Each villein worked several strips, each called an acre.
senses.exampleCN: 每个农奴耕种几条狭长田地，每一条都称作 acre。
senses.why: Before the unit was standardised, an acre was the strip a team could plough in a day, long and narrow.
senses.whyCN: 在单位标准化之前，acre 就是一队人畜一天能犁完的狭长条田。

senses.title: The measuring of land by acres
senses.definition: the practice or system of measuring land in acres, as in surveying and property records
senses.definitionCN: 以英亩为单位丈量土地的做法或制度，见于测量与地产登记
senses.example: The survey measured the plot in acres and chains.
senses.exampleCN: 这次测量用英亩和测链来计这块地。
senses.why: A unit is also a method: whoever measures land must agree on what one acre means.
senses.whyCN: 单位同时是一套方法：量地的人必须对「一英亩有多大」达成一致。

senses.title: Acreage: the total area of land
senses.definition: in the derived noun acreage, the total area of a piece of land measured in acres
senses.definitionCN: 在派生名词 acreage 中，指一块土地以英亩计算的总面积
senses.example: The farm's acreage doubled after the purchase.
senses.exampleCN: 购入之后，这个农场的土地面积翻了一倍。
senses.why: The suffix -age turns the unit into a collective quantity, so acreage names the whole measured area.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -age 把单位变成集合数量，因此 acreage 指整片被量过的面积。

senses.title: God's acre: a churchyard, an old use
senses.definition: in the old phrase God's acre, a churchyard or burial ground beside a church
senses.definitionCN: 旧短语 God's acre 中指教堂旁的墓地或葬地
senses.example: The villagers were buried in God's acre behind the church.
senses.exampleCN: 村民们被葬在教堂后面的墓地里。
senses.why: The dead are laid in a plot of ground that belongs to the church; the field becomes a sacred acre.
senses.whyCN: 逝者被安放在属于教会的一块地里；那块田就成了神圣的一英亩。

intro.en: Acre is an Old English word for a field, and it shares a deep root with Latin ager and Greek agros.
intro.cn: acre 是古英语中表示「田地」的词，与拉丁语 ager、希腊语 agros 共享一个更古老的词根。

items.en: *agro- is generally reconstructed as 'field, open land', from a root meaning to drive or lead.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *agro- 表示「田地、开阔地」，出自一个意为「驱赶、引领」的词根。

items.en: Latin ager meant a field or farm land, and it gave agriculture and agrarian.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ager 意为「田地、农田」，它生出 agriculture 与 agrarian。

items.en: Old English æcer meant a field or a piece of ploughed land, and it also named the unit.
items.cn: 古英语 æcer 意为「田地、犁过的地」，同时也指这个度量单位。

items.en: Middle English aker kept both the field sense and the unit sense while the spelling was still unsettled.
items.cn: 中古英语 aker 同时保留「田地」与「单位」两个意思，拼写当时尚未固定。

items.en: The unit sense won in ordinary use, while the field sense survives mainly in phrases such as broad acres and God's acre.
items.cn: 日常使用中「单位」义胜出，「田地」义则主要残留在 broad acres 与 God's acre 这类短语里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same field root plus two words that only look similar; the near-meaning group gathers other units and words for land.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「田地」词根的几个词，另附两个只是拼写相近的词；近义组收其他面积单位与表示土地的词。

entries.definition: The total area of land measured in acres; formed directly from acre plus -age.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「土地面积、总亩数」，由 acre 加 -age 直接构成。

entries.definition: Farming, literally the cultivation of fields; it shares the root ager with acre.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农业」，字面是「耕种田地」，与 acre 同出 ager 词根。

entries.definition: Bitter or sharp in smell or taste; it merely looks similar, coming from Latin acer meaning sharp.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「辛辣的、刺鼻的」，只是拼写相近，词源不同，出自拉丁语 acer「尖锐的」。

entries.definition: Bitterness in speech or feeling; another word from sharp acer, not from the field root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「尖刻、怨毒」，同样出自「尖锐」的 acer，与田地词根无关。

entries.definition: A metric unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres, about two and a half acres.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「公顷」，等于一万平方米，约合二点五英亩。

entries.definition: The solid surface of the earth, or an area of it owned by someone; the general word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「土地、陆地」，是表示地表或地产的最一般的词。

entries.definition: A large area of land with a house, or the property a person owns.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「地产、庄园」，指带宅邸的大片土地或个人拥有的财产。

entries.definition: An area of open land used for crops or pasture; the original sense of acre.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「田地、田野」，正是 acre 最初的意思。

entries.definition: A small measured piece of land, often for building or growing something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「小块地、地皮」，通常是量好的一小片土地。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English field root and the phrases acre actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的古英语「田地」词根，以及 acre 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Old English æcer is a field: acre began as the name of the ground itself.
normal.cn: 古英语 æcer 就是「田地」：acre 最初是那块地本身的名字。

normal.en: Ager, agros and acre all descend from the same reconstructed field root.
normal.cn: ager、agros 与 acre 都出自同一个重构的「田地」词根。

normal.en: Broad acres is the phrase for a wide estate, not for a single small field.
normal.cn: broad acres 指广阔的田产，而不是一小块地。

normal.en: Acres of space is a joking way to say there is plenty of room.
normal.cn: acres of space 是夸张的说法，表示空间大得很。

normal.en: God's acre is an old name for a churchyard, where the ground belongs to the church.
normal.cn: God's acre 是教堂墓地的旧称，那里的地归教会所有。

abstract.en: Picture a single ox turning at the end of a long narrow strip of soil.
abstract.cn: 想象一头牛在一条狭长土地的尽头转回身。

abstract.en: That strip is one day's ploughing, and the strip later becomes the unit printed on a deed.
abstract.cn: 那条地是一天的犁耕量，而这条地后来变成写在契据上的单位。

abstract.en: Acre is land you can walk over: the measure and the ground are the same picture.
abstract.cn: acre 是能用脚走过去的土地：度量与地面是同一幅画面。

examples.en: The orchard covers twenty acres behind the farmhouse.
examples.cn: 果园占地二十英亩，位于农舍后面。

examples.en: They cleared an acre of woodland for the new barn.
examples.cn: 他们清出一英亩林地用来建新谷仓。

examples.en: The price is about three thousand pounds per acre.
examples.cn: 价格约为每英亩三千英镑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶可」——一诶一可，量出一块地：英亩、田地

root: 古英语 æcer「田地」源自原始印欧语 *agro-「田地、开阔地」，与拉丁语 ager「田地」、希腊语 agros「田野」同源；该词根一般认为出自意为「驱赶、引领」的更早词根。现代义「英亩」由标准大小的田地演变而来。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of acre all keep one picture of measured ground: a unit, a piece of land, a broad estate, a joking amount of room, an old strip, a method of survey, the total acreage, and a churchyard.
sensesIntro.cn: acre 的八个义项都保留同一幅「量过的土地」画面：一个单位、一块地、大片田产、夸张的空间、旧时的条田、丈量方法、总亩数，以及教堂墓地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long strip of ploughed soil that one team can finish in a day.
core.cn: 核心意象：一队人畜一天能犁完的一条狭长土地。

branches.en: THE UNIT: a standard field becomes a fixed measure and a method of survey.
branches.cn: 单位线：一块标准大小的田变成固定尺度，也成为丈量的方法。

branches.en: THE GROUND: the measured unit stands for the land itself, and acreage names the total.
branches.cn: 土地线：度量单位代指土地本身，acreage 则指总面积。

branches.en: THE ESTATE: broad acres turn many fields into visible wealth.
branches.cn: 家业线：broad acres 把许多田地聚成看得见的财富。

branches.en: THE JOKE: acres of space stretches the field into an exaggerated amount of room.
branches.cn: 夸张线：acres of space 把田地拉伸成夸张的空间量。

branches.en: THE OLD LAYERS: the strip is the earliest sense, and God's acre keeps the field as a burial ground.
branches.cn: 旧层线：条田是最早的意义，God's acre 则让田地成为墓地。

intro.en: Acre is a native Old English word; its family grows through suffixes and compounds rather than through Latin prefixes.
intro.cn: acre 是古英语本族词；它的词族靠后缀与复合来扩展，而不是靠拉丁前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin relatives ager, agricola and agrestis are recorded, and they share the reconstructed root *agro-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语同族词 ager、agricola 与 agrestis 均有记录，共享重构词根 *agro-。

items.example: The reconstructed root underlies the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个重构词根是整个词族的基础。

items.example: It is the Latin cousin of acre.
items.exampleCN: 它是 acre 在拉丁语中的同族词。

items.example: It is the direct source of acre.
items.exampleCN: 它是 acre 的直接来源。

items.example: The spelling varied before it settled as acre.
items.exampleCN: 拼写在固定为 acre 之前有过多种写法。
它构成 acreage。
它构成 agriculture 与 agronomy。

items.example: It joins the field root with a cultivating root.
items.exampleCN: 它把「田地」词根与「耕种」词根合在一起。

items.example: It describes what belongs to open country.
items.exampleCN: 它形容属于开阔乡野的事物。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun from ager plus a cultivating root

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -age 构成，义为「土地面积；总亩数」
由本词与 foot 复合，义为「英亩英尺」，一种水量单位

definition_zh: 穿过；横过；在……对面；遍及；宽
definition_en: from one side of something to the other, or on the opposite side
core_image: 一条线从路的一边拉到另一边
scene: 雨后的石板路还积着水，孩子站在巷子这头，望着对面的小书店。He walked across the wet lane to the little bookshop.
sceneCN: 这里 across 是「从一边到另一边」（第 1 个义项：从某处的一侧走到另一侧）；句意为他穿过湿漉漉的小巷，走向那家小书店。

pos.zh: 介词：穿过；横过；在……对面；遍及
副词：横过；在对面；宽

derivatives.zh: 由 across 与 board 复合，义为「全面的、一揽子的」，语义从「横过整块板」偏移为「覆盖所有人」
由同一「十字」词根 cross 构成，义为「十字形；交叉」，语义从「成十字」具体化为交叉的图形
由 cross 加名词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「交叉路口；横渡」，语义从「横过」偏移为「横过之处或之行」

senses.title: From one side to the other
senses.definition: moving or reaching from one side of a place, line or surface to the other
senses.definitionCN: 从一处、一条线或一个表面的一侧移动到另一侧
senses.example: She swam across the river before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 她在日出前游过了那条河。
senses.why: Old French a croix meant in the form of a cross: a line drawn from side to side is the first picture.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 a croix 意为「成十字形」：从一侧拉到另一侧的那条线就是最初的画面。

senses.title: On the opposite side
senses.definition: positioned on the other side of something such as a road, river or room
senses.definitionCN: 位于道路、河流或房间等的另一侧
senses.example: The bakery is across the square from the town hall.
senses.exampleCN: 面包店在广场上，正对着市政厅。
senses.why: If something goes from here to there, the place it reaches is also described as across.
senses.whyCN: 既然某物从这里到了那里，它抵达的那一侧同样可以用 across 来描述。

senses.title: Extending over something
senses.definition: stretching or placed over the whole width of something, such as a bridge over a river
senses.definitionCN: 伸过或架在某物的整个宽度上，如河上的桥
senses.example: A new bridge was built across the narrow gorge.
senses.exampleCN: 一座新桥横跨那道狭窄的峡谷。
senses.why: The line from side to side can be a solid thing: a bridge is across the water it spans.
senses.whyCN: 那条从一边到另一边的线可以是实体：桥就横在它所跨越的水面上。

senses.title: Throughout an area
senses.definition: in or affecting every part of a region, country or group
senses.definitionCN: 在某地区、国家或群体的每个部分之内或影响所及
senses.example: The news spread across the whole province in a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这条消息一天之内传遍全省。
senses.why: A line drawn from one edge to the other covers everything between, so across comes to mean all over.
senses.whyCN: 从一边拉到另一边的线覆盖了中间的一切，于是 across 引申为「遍布」。

senses.title: Crossing or intersecting
senses.definition: meeting or passing another thing at an angle so that the two cross each other
senses.definitionCN: 以一定角度与另一物相遇或穿过，使两者相交
senses.example: A dirt track runs across the main road just outside the village.
senses.exampleCN: 一条土路在村外不远处与主路交叉。
senses.why: The original idea is a cross, and two lines that meet at an angle form exactly that shape.
senses.whyCN: 最初的意思就是「十字」，而两条以一定角度相遇的线正好构成那个形状。

senses.title: Measured in width
senses.definition: used after a measurement to state the width of something from one side to the other
senses.definitionCN: 用在度量之后，表示某物从一侧到另一侧的宽度
senses.example: The pool is ten metres across at its widest point.
senses.exampleCN: 这个水池最宽处有十米宽。
senses.why: Measuring from one side to the other is the same movement as crossing, only frozen into a number.
senses.whyCN: 从一侧量到另一侧和横穿是同一种移动，只是它凝固成了一个数字。

senses.title: Get across: to be understood
senses.definition: in the phrase get across, to succeed in making an idea or feeling understood by others
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 get across，指成功让他人理解某个想法或感受
senses.example: The teacher used a drawing to get the idea across.
senses.exampleCN: 老师用一幅图把这个概念讲清楚。
senses.why: An idea must travel from one mind to another; if it reaches the other side, it has got across.
senses.whyCN: 想法必须从一个头脑到达另一个头脑；若它抵达了对岸，就是 get across。

senses.title: Across from: facing something
senses.definition: in the phrase across from, directly opposite a person, building or place
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 across from，指正对着某人、某建筑或某地
senses.example: He sat across from me at the long wooden table.
senses.exampleCN: 他坐在长木桌的对面，正对着我。
senses.why: Two people on opposite sides of a table are joined by the same line that across describes.
senses.whyCN: 桌子两侧的两个人正是被 across 所描述的那条线连接起来的。

intro.en: Across goes back to a French phrase meaning in the form of a cross, built on the Latin word for a cross.
intro.cn: across 可追溯到一句意为「成十字形」的法语短语，其核心是拉丁语中表示「十字」的词。

items.en: crux meant a cross, a stake or a crossing, and it is the source of the whole cross family.
items.cn: crux 意为「十字、木桩、交叉处」，是整个「十字」词族的源头。

items.en: Old French croix meant a cross, and the phrase a croix meant in the form of a cross, crosswise.
items.cn: 古法语 croix 意为「十字」，短语 a croix 意为「成十字形、交叉地」。

items.en: Middle English a-crois, later written acros, came from that phrase and first meant crosswise.
items.cn: 中古英语 a-crois（后来写作 acros）来自那句短语，最初意为「交叉地」。

items.en: The sense widened from crosswise to from one side to the other; the early spellings vary and exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 词义从「交叉地」扩大到「从一边到另一边」；早期拼写有多种，确切年代不确定。

items.en: The adverb, the preposition and the fixed phrases across from and get across all belong to later English.
items.cn: 副词用法、介词用法以及 across from、get across 这类固定短语都属于较晚的英语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same crux cross family; the near-meaning group gathers prepositions of movement and position that overlap with across.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 crux「十字」词族的词；近义组收与 across 意义相交叠的移动与方位介词。

entries.definition: A shape of two crossing lines, or to go from one side to the other; the source word behind across.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「十字形、横过」，是 across 背后的来源词。

entries.definition: A place where one may cross, or the act of crossing water or a road.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交叉路口、横渡」，指可以横过之处或横过的行为。

entries.definition: The central or decisive point of a problem; literally a cross, from the same Latin word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「症结、关键」，字面是「十字」，出自同一拉丁词。

entries.definition: A long campaign fought for a cause; its name came from the cross worn by its fighters.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「十字军东征、运动」，名称来自战士身上所佩的十字。

entries.definition: From one end or side of something to the other, often passing inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或副词，义为「穿过、通过」，常强调从内部穿过。

entries.definition: Above and to the other side of something, as in jumping over a wall.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或副词，义为「越过、在……上方」，如跳过一堵墙。

entries.definition: On the farther side of something, at a greater distance.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或副词，义为「在……更远处、越过」，强调距离更远的一侧。

entries.definition: In every part of a place or period; the emphatic form of the throughout sense of across.
entries.definitionCN: 介词或副词，义为「遍及、贯穿」，是 across「遍及」义的强化说法。

entries.definition: Facing something on the other side; the adjective behind across from.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或介词，义为「对面的」，正是 across from 背后的那个词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin crux root and the phrases across actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 crux 词根，以及 across 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: croix is a cross: across began as in a cross, a line drawn from side to side.
normal.cn: croix 是「十字」：across 最初意为「成十字形」，即从一边拉到另一边的一条线。

normal.en: Cross, crux and crusade all come from the same Latin crux.
normal.cn: cross、crux 与 crusade 都出自同一个拉丁词 crux。

normal.en: Across from is the fixed phrase for sitting or living opposite something.
normal.cn: across from 是表示「坐在或住在某物对面」的固定搭配。

normal.en: Get across is about ideas, not roads: making a point reach the other side.
normal.cn: get across 说的是想法而不是道路：让一个观点抵达对方那一边。

normal.en: Ten metres across measures width, the distance from one bank to the other.
normal.cn: ten metres across 量的是宽度，即从这一岸到那一岸的距离。

abstract.en: Picture a straight line drawn over a sheet of paper from the left edge to the right edge.
abstract.cn: 想象在纸上从左边沿到右边沿画一条笔直的线。

abstract.en: The same line can be a bridge, a swim, a rumour or an idea travelling to another mind.
abstract.cn: 同一条线可以是桥、可以是一次泅渡、一则传言，也可以是一个抵达另一个头脑的想法。

abstract.en: Across always means the far side has been reached, not merely approached.
abstract.cn: across 始终意味着已经抵达对面，而不只是靠近。

examples.en: We walked across the bridge and down to the harbour.
examples.cn: 我们走过桥，一路下到港口。

examples.en: The message got across despite the noise.
examples.cn: 尽管有噪音，这个意思还是传达清楚了。

examples.en: The old church stands across from the school.
examples.cn: 那座老教堂就在学校对面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额克罗斯」——额前一划，画个十字，横着穿过去

root: 中古英语 a-crois 来自古法语短语 a croix「成十字形」；croix 出自拉丁语 crux「十字、交叉」。词义由「交叉地」扩展为「从一边到另一边」，再由空间义引申出「遍及」与「在对面」。更早的印欧来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of across all draw one line from side to side: movement, the far side, a bridge, a whole region, a crossing, a width, an idea that lands, and a seat opposite someone.
sensesIntro.cn: across 的八个义项都在画同一条从一侧到另一侧的线：移动、对面、横跨、全境、交叉、宽度、被领会的想法，以及对面而坐的位置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn from one edge of a surface to the other edge.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条从表面一侧画到另一侧的线。

branches.en: THE LINE: a cross shape is what two lines make, and crossing is what the line does.
branches.cn: 线条线：两条线构成十字，而「横过」正是这条线所做的事。

branches.en: THE FAR SIDE: once reached, the other side becomes a place, and two people can face each other there.
branches.cn: 对岸线：一旦抵达，另一侧就成了一个位置，两个人可以在那里相对而坐。

branches.en: THE SPAN: the line becomes a solid bridge laid over a gap.
branches.cn: 跨越线：那条线变成架在缺口上的实体桥梁。

branches.en: THE REGION: a line covering the whole width also covers everything in between.
branches.cn: 全境线：覆盖整个宽度的线也覆盖了中间的一切。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: the crossing freezes into a width, or travels as an idea into another mind.
branches.cn: 度量线：横过凝固成一个宽度，或作为想法进入另一个头脑。

intro.en: Across is not built from Latin prefixes inside English; it is a frozen French phrase, and its relatives come from the cross root.
intro.cn: across 在英语内部并不是靠拉丁前缀构成的，它是一个凝固的法语短语，其同族词都出自「十字」词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin crux and its family are recorded, and the French forms croix and crois carry it into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crux 及其词族均有记录，法语形式 croix 与 crois 把它带入英语。

items.example: It is the root of the whole cross family.
items.exampleCN: 它是整个「十字」词族的根。

items.example: The phrase a croix meant crosswise.
items.exampleCN: 短语 a croix 意为「成十字形」。

items.structure: Old French preposition in the phrase
items.example: It links the phrase to the noun for a cross.
items.exampleCN: 它把这句短语与「十字」这一名词连接起来。

items.example: It is the English cousin of croix.
items.exampleCN: 它是 croix 在英语中的同族词。

items.example: It appears in cruciform and crucifix.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 cruciform 与 crucifix 中。
它构成 crossing。

items.example: The cross became the hardest point of a problem.
items.exampleCN: 「十字」变成了问题中最难的那一点。

items.example: The name came from the cross the fighters wore.
items.exampleCN: 这个名字来自战士所佩的十字。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb from crux plus figere

derivatives.zh: 由本词与 board 复合，义为「全面的、一揽子的」
由同一词根 cross 加 -ing 构成，义为「交叉路口；横渡」

definition_zh: 行为；行动；法案；一幕；表演；扮演；起作用；装样子
definition_en: to do something, or a single thing that is done, including a performance or a law
core_image: 一个人伸手做出一个动作，幕布随之升起
scene: 放学后的教室空了一半，一个女孩默默把倒下的椅子扶起来。Her act of kindness changed the way the whole class saw her.
sceneCN: 这里 act 是「具体的举动」（第 1 个义项：一个人做的一件具体的事）；句意为她这一个善意的举动改变了全班对她的看法。

pos.zh: 名词：行为；举动；法案；幕
动词：行动；表演；扮演；起作用

derivatives.zh: 由 act 加名词后缀 -ion 构成，义为「行动；作用；诉讼」，语义从「一次举动」偏移为「行动的过程与效力」
由 act 加形容词后缀 -ive 构成，义为「活跃的；主动的；起作用的」
由 act 加施动名词后缀 -or 构成，义为「演员；行动者」
由前缀 en- 加 act 构成，义为「制定（法律）；演出」，语义从「做出」偏移为「使成为法」
由 act 加形容词后缀 -ual 构成，义为「实际的；真实的」，语义从「行动」偏移为「已做成的、真实的」

senses.title: A single thing that someone does
senses.definition: one thing that a person does, often judged by its effect or its intention
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所做的一件具体的事，常按它的效果或意图来评判
senses.example: Her act of kindness changed the way the whole class saw her.
senses.exampleCN: 她那个善意的举动改变了全班对她的看法。
senses.why: Latin actus is a doing; the smallest visible unit of doing is one deed that can be pointed at.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actus 意为「做」；看得见的最小「做」的单元，就是可以指着说的那一件事。

senses.title: The process of doing something
senses.definition: the doing of something, especially at the very moment it is happening
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的过程，尤指事情正在发生的那一瞬间
senses.example: The thief was caught in the act of opening the safe.
senses.exampleCN: 小偷在开保险箱的时候被当场抓住。
senses.why: The same noun can name not the deed but the doing, and in the act of pins it to one moment.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词可以不指「那件事」，而指「做的过程」，in the act of 就是把它钉在某一刻。

senses.title: A pretence or false show
senses.definition: behaviour that is put on to impress or deceive other people
senses.definitionCN: 为了给人好印象或骗人而装出来的行为
senses.example: His calm was just an act to hide how nervous he was.
senses.exampleCN: 他的镇定只是装样子，用来掩盖自己的紧张。
senses.why: If acting is playing a part, then a show of feeling that is not real is an act in everyday speech.
senses.whyCN: 既然演戏是扮演一个角色，那么日常口语里装出来的情绪也就是一场 act。

senses.title: One division of a play
senses.definition: a main division of a play or opera, marked by a change of time, place or action
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧或歌剧的一个主要段落，以时间、地点或情节的变化为标志
senses.example: The second act opens in a dark garden.
senses.exampleCN: 第二幕开场在一座黑暗的花园里。
senses.why: A play is a series of doings; each block of doing, marked off by the curtain, is one act.
senses.whyCN: 一出戏就是一串「做」；被帷幕隔开的每一块「做」，就是一幕。

senses.title: To perform on stage or screen
senses.definition: to perform in a play, film or show, especially as a job
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧、电影或演出中表演，尤指以此为职业
senses.example: She has acted in three films this year.
senses.exampleCN: 她今年出演了三部电影。
senses.why: The verb repeats the deed in public: to act is to do things in front of an audience.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「做」搬到公众面前：act 就是在观众眼前做出那些举动。

senses.title: To have an effect on something
senses.definition: to produce an effect on something, especially a medicine, a force or a chemical
senses.definitionCN: 对某物产生作用，尤指药物、力量或化学物质
senses.example: The drug acts on the nerves that carry pain signals.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药作用于传递疼痛信号的神经。
senses.why: A force or a drug also does something; acting on an object is the doing of a thing without hands.
senses.whyCN: 力量或药物同样在「做」；act on 某物，就是不用手也能发生的那种「做」。

senses.title: A law passed by a parliament
senses.definition: a formal decision of a parliament or similar body that becomes law
senses.definitionCN: 议会或类似机构作出的正式决定，通过后成为法律
senses.example: Parliament passed an act to protect the river.
senses.exampleCN: 议会通过了一项保护这条河流的法案。
senses.why: A law is the state's deed: what the assembly has done is written down and called an act.
senses.whyCN: 法律就是国家的「作为」：议会做完的事被写下来，称为一项 act。

senses.title: To play a particular role
senses.definition: to pretend to be a particular person in a story so that an audience believes it
senses.definitionCN: 在故事中假扮某个特定人物，让观众信以为真
senses.example: He acted the part of the old king with great dignity.
senses.exampleCN: 他把老国王这个角色演得极有威严。
senses.why: Playing a part is doing someone else's deeds; the verb carries the character as its object.
senses.whyCN: 扮演一个角色，就是做出别人的举动；这个动词把角色当作自己的宾语。

intro.en: Act goes back to a Latin verb of driving and doing, whose noun actus named both a deed and a performance.
intro.cn: act 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「驱动、做」的动词，其名词 actus 既指「行为」也指「表演」。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as to drive, lead or move, and it underlies a large family of Latin verbs.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 意为「驱赶、引领、推动」，它是拉丁语一大批动词的基础。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive, lead or perform, and it also gave agenda, agent and agile.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、引领、演出」，它还生出 agenda、agent 与 agile。

items.en: The noun actus named a doing, a driving, and also a division of a play.
items.cn: 名词 actus 指「行为、驱动」，也指戏剧的一个段落。

items.en: Old French acte meant a deed and a part of a play, and it carried the word into English.
items.cn: 古法语 acte 意为「行为」与「戏剧的一幕」，它把这个词带入英语。

items.en: English took the noun from French and the verb from Latin; the legal sense of a statute grew in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语从法语借入名词，从拉丁语借入动词；「法令」这一法律义在十六世纪发展起来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same agere family; the near-meaning group gathers other words for deeds, laws and performing.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 agere 词族的词；近义组收表示行为、法令与表演的其他词。

entries.definition: The process or an instance of doing something; formed from act plus -ion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、行为」，由 act 加 -ion 构成，比 act 更强调过程。

entries.definition: Busy, doing things, or producing an effect; formed from act plus -ive.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、起作用的」，由 act 加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: A person who performs roles; formed from act plus the doer suffix -or.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，由 act 加表施动的后缀 -or 构成。

entries.definition: To make a law, or to perform a scene; built with the prefix en- on the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「制定法律、演出」，由前缀 en- 加同一词根构成。

entries.definition: A thing done, especially something notable; more formal and more moral than act.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行为、事迹」，比 act 更正式，也更带道德评判色彩。

entries.definition: The act of staging a play, concert or show, or how well someone does something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演出、表现」，指把戏搬上台，或指完成某事的好坏。

entries.definition: To act in a particular way, especially in front of others; the verb of conduct.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「表现、举止」，尤指在他人面前的行为方式。

entries.definition: A written law passed by a legislature; the technical term for what an act contains.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「成文法、法规」，是法案内容的法律术语。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin agere root and the phrases act actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 agere 词根，以及 act 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: *ag- is to drive: act is the drive made visible as a deed.
normal.cn: *ag- 是「驱动」：act 就是被看见的一件行为。

normal.en: Action, active, actor and enact all grow from the same agere.
normal.cn: action、active、actor 与 enact 都从同一个 agere 长出来。

normal.en: An act of Parliament is the deed of the state written into law.
normal.cn: an act of Parliament 就是国家做下的事，被写成法律。

normal.en: In the act of catches someone at the very moment of doing it.
normal.cn: in the act of 表示正好在某人做那件事的一瞬间抓住他。

normal.en: Act on means a force or a drug is working on something.
normal.cn: act on 指某种力量或药物正在对某物发生作用。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching out and touching a switch: the room lights up.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸出去按下开关，房间立刻亮了起来。

abstract.en: One small motion can be a kindness, a crime, a stage entrance or a law.
abstract.cn: 一个小动作可以是善举、罪行、登场，也可以成为一条法律。

abstract.en: Act is any doing that becomes visible enough to be named.
abstract.cn: act 就是任何明显到可以被命名的一次「做」。

examples.en: He acted at once when the alarm rang.
examples.cn: 警报一响，他立刻行动起来。

examples.en: Parliament passed an act to protect the river.
examples.cn: 议会通过了一项保护这条河流的法案。

examples.en: Stop acting like a child and tell me the truth.
examples.cn: 别像个孩子那样装样子了，把真相告诉我。

root: 拉丁语 actus「行为、驱动」与动词 agere「做、驱动、引领」同源，出自原始印欧语 *ag-「驱赶、推动」。agere 还生出 agent、agenda、action 等词。英语名词经由古法语 acte 借入，动词直取拉丁语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of act all name one doing: a deed, a doing in progress, a pretence, a section of a play, performing, acting on something, a law, and playing a role.
sensesIntro.cn: act 的八个义项都在命名同一次「做」：一件行为、正在做的过程、装出来的样子、一幕戏、表演、对某物起作用、一条法律，以及扮演一个角色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand stretches out and makes one visible movement.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸出去，做出一个看得见的动作。

branches.en: THE DEED: doing produces a visible act, and the doing itself can be caught in progress.
branches.cn: 行为线：「做」产生看得见的行为，而做的过程本身也能被当场撞见。

branches.en: THE MASK: what looks like a deed can be a show put on for others.
branches.cn: 面具线：看起来像行为的东西，也可能是演给别人看的样子。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a play is divided into acts, performers act, and they act particular roles.
branches.cn: 舞台线：戏被分成幕，演员表演，并且演出特定的角色。

branches.en: THE FORCE: a drug or a law of nature also does something to an object.
branches.cn: 作用线：药物或自然规律同样会对某物「做」些什么。

branches.en: THE STATE: a parliament's deed is written down and becomes an act.
branches.cn: 国家线：议会的作为被写下来，成为一项法案。

intro.en: Act is a Latin root word in English; a few prefixes and suffixes build the rest of its family.
intro.cn: act 是英语中的拉丁词根词；少量前缀与后缀构成了它的其余词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere, actus and actio are all recorded, and the root *ag- is a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere、actus 与 actio 均有记录，而词根 *ag- 属于重构形式。

items.example: The reconstructed root supplies the idea of motion.
items.exampleCN: 这个重构词根提供「运动」的观念。

items.example: The verb is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整个词族的源头。

items.example: It is the direct Latin source of act.
items.exampleCN: 它是 act 直接的拉丁语来源。
它构成 action。
它构成 active。
它构成 actor。
它构成 actual。
它构成 enact。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「行动；作用；诉讼」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「活跃的；主动的」
由本词加 -or 构成，义为「演员；行动者」
由 en- 加本词构成，义为「制定法律；演出」

definition_zh: 行动；措施；作用；战斗；诉讼；情节
definition_en: the process of doing something, or a thing done to reach a result or produce an effect
core_image: 静止的画面忽然动起来，一只手从画面里伸出来
scene: 河边的水井被污水泡了整整一个夏天，居民反复投诉却始终没有回应。The committee finally took action and closed the polluted well.
sceneCN: 这里 action 是「行动」（第 1 个义项：为达成目的而动手去做）；句意为委员会终于采取行动，封闭了那口被污染的井。

pos.zh: 名词：行动；措施；作用；战斗；诉讼；情节

derivatives.zh: 由 action 去掉名词后缀 -ion 再加 -ive 构成，义为「活跃的；主动的」
由同一词根 act 加 -or 构成，义为「行动者；演员」
由 active 加动词后缀 -ate 构成，义为「使启动；激活」
由 action 加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「可据以行动的；可起诉的」

senses.title: The process of doing something
senses.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to reach a goal
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的过程，尤指为了达到某个目标而动起来
senses.example: The committee finally took action and closed the polluted well.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会终于采取行动，封闭了那口被污染的井。
senses.why: Latin actio is a doing; action is the doing seen as a stretch of time with a purpose.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actio 意为「做」；action 就是被看成一段有目的的时间的那个「做」。

senses.title: A step taken to deal with a problem
senses.definition: a particular thing done in order to solve a problem or improve a situation
senses.definitionCN: 为解决某个问题或改善某种状况而做的具体一件事
senses.example: Cleaning the drains was one of the first actions of the new mayor.
senses.exampleCN: 清理下水道是新市长最先采取的举措之一。
senses.why: A large aim breaks into small doings; each one is an action that can be counted and checked.
senses.whyCN: 一个大目标会拆成许多小的「做」；每一件都是可以计数、可以检查的措施。

senses.title: The effect that something has
senses.definition: the way a force, substance or mechanism produces an effect on something
senses.definitionCN: 某种力量、物质或机制对某物产生效果的方式
senses.example: The action of the acid on the metal was almost immediate.
senses.exampleCN: 酸对金属的作用几乎是立刻发生的。
senses.why: Things without hands still do things; their working is called their action.
senses.whyCN: 没有手的东西也照样在「做」；它们的工作方式就被称作它们的 action。

senses.title: Fighting in a war
senses.definition: military fighting, especially a small engagement or a period of combat
senses.definitionCN: 军事交火，尤指一次小规模交战或一段战斗
senses.example: He was wounded in action near the border.
senses.exampleCN: 他在边境附近的战斗中负伤。
senses.why: War is the most violent form of doing, so a piece of fighting is simply an action.
senses.whyCN: 战争是最激烈的「做」，因此一场交战就被直接称为 action。

senses.title: A case brought to court
senses.definition: a legal case in which one party sues another and asks a court to decide
senses.definitionCN: 一方起诉另一方、请求法院裁决的法律案件
senses.example: The tenants brought an action against the landlord.
senses.exampleCN: 租户对房东提起了诉讼。
senses.why: Latin actio also meant a lawsuit: the plaintiff's doing is the formal step that starts the case.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actio 也指「诉讼」：原告的那一步「做」，就是启动案件的形式动作。

senses.title: The events of a film or story
senses.titleCN: （影片或故事的）情节、动作场面
senses.definition: the sequence of exciting events in a film, novel or game
senses.definitionCN: 电影、小说或游戏中一连串紧张刺激的事件
senses.example: The film is full of action from the first minute.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影从第一分钟起就充满动作场面。
senses.why: A story is a chain of doings; the parts where things happen fastest are called the action.
senses.whyCN: 故事是一连串「做」；事情发生得最快的那部分就被称为 action。

senses.title: The working of a machine
senses.definition: the way a machine or mechanism moves and works, especially its moving parts
senses.definitionCN: 机器或机构的运动方式，尤指其运动部件的工作
senses.example: The action of the pump is controlled by a small valve.
senses.exampleCN: 泵的动作由一个小阀门控制。
senses.why: A machine is built to do; its repeated motion is the action designed into it.
senses.whyCN: 机器就是为「做」而造的；它反复的运动就是被设计进去的 action。

senses.title: In action: while working
senses.definition: in the phrase in action, while operating, working or taking part in an activity
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 in action，指正在运转、工作或参与活动
senses.example: The photographs show the new bridge in action.
senses.exampleCN: 这些照片展示了新桥投入使用的情景。
senses.why: To see something in action is to see it doing what it was made to do.
senses.whyCN: see something in action 就是看它做出它被造出来该做的那件事。

intro.en: Action is the Latin noun of doing, a companion of act and built on the same verb agere.
intro.cn: action 是拉丁语中表示「做」的名词，与 act 同族，建立在同一个动词 agere 上。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as to drive or lead, and it supplies the motion inside the family.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 意为「驱赶、引领」，它为整个词族提供「运动」的内核。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive or perform, and its noun actio named a doing, a gesture or a lawsuit.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、演出」，其名词 actio 指「行为、手势、诉讼」。

items.en: Old French accion carried the noun into English with the legal and the general senses already present.
items.cn: 古法语 accion 把这个名词带入英语，法律义与一般义当时已经并存。

items.en: The word is recorded in English in the fourteenth century; exact first dates and spellings are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词在十四世纪的英语中有记录；确切的首见年代与拼写不确定。

items.en: The military sense and the film sense are later growths, and in action became a fixed phrase.
items.cn: 军事义与电影义都是较晚的发展，in action 则成了固定短语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same agere family; the near-meaning group gathers words for deeds, measures, effects, battles and lawsuits.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 agere 词族；近义组收表示行为、措施、作用、战斗与诉讼的词。

entries.definition: A single deed, a law, or to perform; the shorter noun and verb behind action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「行为、法案、表演」，是 action 背后更短的名词与动词。

entries.definition: Busy or producing an effect; the adjective describes what is full of action.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活跃的、起作用的」，形容充满 action 的状态。

entries.definition: Someone who performs, or a party that acts; the doer behind the deed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，是行为背后的施动者。

entries.definition: To make something start working; formed from active plus -ate.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使启动、激活」，由 active 加 -ate 构成。

entries.definition: Giving enough reason to act or to sue; formed from action plus -able.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可据以行动的、可起诉的」，由 action 加 -able 构成。

entries.definition: A thing done, especially a notable or moral one; more formal than action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行为、事迹」，比 action 更正式，也更带道德色彩。

entries.definition: A step or plan taken to deal with a problem; the policy sense of action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「措施、办法」，对应 action 中「举措」那一义。

entries.definition: The working of a machine, system or force; close to the effect sense of action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运转、操作、作用」，接近 action 的「作用、运转」义。

entries.definition: A case brought to a court by one party against another.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「诉讼」，指一方向法院起诉另一方的案件。

entries.definition: A fight between armed forces; a larger and more concrete word than action.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「战斗、战役」，比 action 更具体、规模更大。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin agere root and the phrases action actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 agere 词根，以及 action 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: agere is to do: action is doing seen as a stretch of time.
normal.cn: agere 是「做」：action 就是把「做」看成一段持续的时间。

normal.en: Act, action, active and actor all share the same three letters and the same root.
normal.cn: act、action、active 与 actor 共享同样三个字母，也共享同一个词根。

normal.en: Take action is the fixed phrase for moving from talk to doing.
normal.cn: take action 是「从说到做」的固定说法。

normal.en: A legal action is a lawsuit, not a physical movement.
normal.cn: legal action 是诉讼，不是身体的动作。

normal.en: In action means a thing is working, not merely existing.
normal.cn: in action 表示某物正在运转，而不只是存在着。

abstract.en: Picture a still photograph that suddenly begins to move at one corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一张静止的照片忽然从一个角落开始动起来。

abstract.en: The moving corner can be a hand, a piston, an acid eating metal, or a crowd marching.
abstract.cn: 那个动起来的角落可以是一只手、一个活塞、腐蚀金属的酸，或一支行进的队伍。

abstract.en: Action is what turns a plan into something that leaves a trace.
abstract.cn: action 就是把计划变成留下痕迹之物的那股力量。

examples.en: The school took action to reduce food waste.
examples.cn: 学校采取了行动来减少食物浪费。

examples.en: The acid's action on the metal was immediate.
examples.cn: 酸对金属的作用是立刻发生的。

examples.en: The film is full of action from the first minute.
examples.cn: 这部电影从第一分钟起就满是动作场面。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of action all show doing at work: a stretch of doing, a measure, an effect, a fight, a lawsuit, a plot, a machine's motion, and the phrase in action.
sensesIntro.cn: action 的八个义项都在展示「做」在起作用：一段行动、一项措施、一种效力、一场战斗、一桩诉讼、一段情节、机器的运转，以及 in action 这个短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a still scene begins to move, and a hand comes out of it.
core.cn: 核心意象：静止的画面开始动起来，一只手从中伸出。

branches.en: THE DOING: action is both a stretch of doing and a countable step taken for a goal.
branches.cn: 行动线：action 既是一段持续的行动，也是为达成目标而走出的一步。

branches.en: THE FORCE: acids, forces and machines all act, and their working is their action.
branches.cn: 作用线：酸、力与机器都会作用，它们的工作方式就是它们的 action。

branches.en: THE WAR: a piece of fighting is doing at its most violent.
branches.cn: 战场线：一场交战就是「做」最激烈的形式。

branches.en: THE COURT: the plaintiff's formal step starts a case called an action.
branches.cn: 法庭线：原告走出的正式一步，启动了被称为 action 的案件。

branches.en: THE MOMENT: a story's fast events and a machine's working are doing caught in the present.

senses.title: Busy and moving
senses.definition: busy with many activities; not idle, still or passive
senses.definitionCN: 忙于许多活动；不闲散、不停滞、不被动
senses.example: She stays active by cycling to school every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早晨骑车上学，保持着活跃的生活。
senses.why: The Latin root agere is to do; active describes a person or thing that is full of doing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 agere 是「做」；active 形容一个人或物充满了「做」。

senses.title: Taking the initiative
senses.definition: choosing to do something rather than waiting to be told or forced
senses.definitionCN: 自己选择去做，而不是等着被吩咐或被逼迫
senses.example: He played an active part in the negotiations.
senses.exampleCN: 他在谈判中发挥了积极的作用。
senses.why: Doing that starts from oneself is active; doing that is done to oneself is passive.
senses.whyCN: 由自己发起的「做」是主动的；被别人施加的「做」是被动的。

senses.title: Producing an effect
senses.definition: having an effect, especially as the effective part of a medicine or mixture
senses.definitionCN: 能产生效果的，尤指药物或混合物中真正起作用的部分
senses.example: The active ingredient in the tablet is aspirin.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药片中的有效成分是阿司匹林。
senses.why: Of all the parts of a mixture, the one that actually works is the one that is active.
senses.whyCN: 在混合物的所有成分中，真正起作用的那一个才是 active 的。

senses.title: Chemically reactive
senses.definition: able to react with other substances; not inert or stable
senses.definitionCN: 能与其他物质发生反应；不是惰性或稳定的
senses.example: The powder contains active metals that must be kept dry.
senses.exampleCN: 这种粉末含有活性金属，必须保持干燥。
senses.why: In chemistry, a substance that can still do something to another substance is active; a quiet one is inert.
senses.whyCN: 在化学里，还能对别的物质「做」些什么的物质是活性的；安安静静的那一类则叫惰性。

senses.title: Serving full time in the forces
senses.definition: on full-time military service, as opposed to reserve or retired duty
senses.definitionCN: 全职服役的军人，相对于预备役或退役状态
senses.example: Her brother is on active duty in the navy.
senses.exampleCN: 她哥哥正在海军现役服役。
senses.why: A soldier is active when he is actually doing the job, not merely listed as available.
senses.whyCN: 军人真正在做这份工作而非仅列在名册上可召时，就是现役的。

senses.title: The active voice in grammar
senses.definition: the verb form in which the subject performs the action rather than receiving it
senses.definitionCN: 主语自己做动作、而不是承受动作的动词形式
senses.example: The sentence is clearer in the active voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这句话用主动语态更清楚。
senses.why: Grammar borrowed the same contrast: the subject either does or is done to.
senses.whyCN: 语法借用了同一种对比：主语要么自己「做」，要么被别人「做」。

senses.title: A volcano that may erupt
senses.definition: a volcano that is not extinct and may erupt again
senses.definitionCN: 尚未熄灭、可能再次喷发的火山
senses.example: The island has one active volcano and several quiet ones.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛上有一座活火山和几座安静的火山。
senses.why: A volcano that still does something is active; one that will never again erupt is extinct.
senses.whyCN: 还会「做」点什么的火山是活的；不会再喷发的则已熄灭。

senses.title: An account still in use
senses.titleCN: 活跃账户；仍在使用的账户
senses.definition: an account or subscription that is still being used or paid for
senses.definitionCN: 仍在使用或仍在付费的账户或订阅
senses.example: The old email account is no longer active.
senses.exampleCN: 那个旧邮箱账户已经不再活跃了。
senses.why: An account is active while things are still happening in it; once it is closed, it is dead.
senses.whyCN: 账户里还在发生事情时它是 active 的；一旦注销，它就是死的。

intro.en: Active is a Latin adjective of doing, formed on the same verb that gave act and action.
intro.cn: active 是拉丁语中表示「做」的形容词，建立在给出 act 与 action 的同一个动词上。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as to drive or lead, the motion behind the whole family.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 意为「驱赶、引领」，是整个词族背后的运动。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive or perform, and its participle supplied the stem act-.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、演出」，其分词提供词干 act-。

items.en: activus meant practical, busy or active, used first of a life of action rather than of thought.
items.cn: activus 意为「实践的、忙碌的、活跃的」，最初用来形容行动的生活，而不是沉思的生活。

items.en: Old French actif carried the adjective into English, where it was first used of practical affairs.
items.cn: 古法语 actif 把这个形容词带入英语，最初用于实际事务。

items.en: The word spread from practical life to people, medicines, volcanoes and grammar; the exact dates of each shift are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词从实际生活扩展到人、药物、火山与语法；每一次扩展的确切年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same agere family; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for energy, motion and being in use.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 agere 词族；近义组收表示精力、运动与正在使用状态的形容词。

entries.definition: The doing itself; the noun that active turns into a quality.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、作用」，是 active 所转化成的性质背后的名词。

entries.definition: A person who performs or acts; the doer described by the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员、行动者」，正是这种形容词所描述的那个施动者。

entries.definition: Something done, or the state of doing things; formed from active plus -ity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「活动、活力」，由 active 加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: To make something start working; formed from active plus -ate.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使启动、激活」，由 active 加 -ate 构成。

entries.definition: To make a law or perform a scene; the same acting root with the prefix en-.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「制定法律、演出」，同一「做」的词根加前缀 en-。

entries.definition: Full of energy and ready to move; stresses the supply of force behind being active.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「精力充沛的」，强调活跃背后的那股力量。

entries.definition: Full of life and movement, often in a cheerful way; used of people and places.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「活泼的、有生气的」，常用于人和场所，带愉快色彩。

entries.definition: Having a lot to do; about being occupied rather than about producing an effect.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「忙的」，强调有事在做，而不强调产生影响。

entries.definition: Changing, forceful and full of energy; often used of systems and personalities.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有活力的、动态的」，常用于系统与性格。

normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 activus 词根，以及 active 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: agere is to do: active means full of doing.
normal.cn: agere 是「做」：active 就是充满「做」。

normal.en: The same root gives act, action, actor and activity.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 act、action、actor 与 activity。

normal.en: An active ingredient is the part of a medicine that really works.
normal.cn: active ingredient 是药物里真正起作用的那部分。

normal.en: Active duty means a soldier is actually serving, not waiting in reserve.
normal.cn: active duty 指军人真正在服役，而不是在预备役里等待。

normal.en: The active voice is the subject doing the action.
normal.cn: active voice 是主语自己做动作的语态。

abstract.en: Picture a small gear that will not stop turning, and the whole machine moves with it.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚小小的齿轮停不下来地转动，整台机器都随之动起来。

abstract.en: The same turning gear can be a runner, a medicine, a volcano or a live account.
abstract.cn: 同一枚转动的齿轮可以是奔跑的人、一味药、一座火山，或一个还在用的账户。

abstract.en: Active is not merely existing; it is still doing something.
abstract.cn: active 不只是存在着，而是仍在做点什么。

examples.en: My grandfather is still active in the village committee.
examples.cn: 我祖父仍在村委里积极做事。

examples.en: The active ingredient makes the cream work quickly.
examples.cn: 有效成分让这种药膏很快见效。

examples.en: Several active volcanoes lie along that coast.
examples.cn: 那片海岸沿线有几座活火山。

sensesIntro.cn: active 的八个义项都在表示某物仍在「做」：忙碌的人、主动的姿态、有效的成分、能反应的物质、服役的军人、语法的语态、活的火山，以及在用的账户。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gear that never stops turning and drives the whole machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚从不停转、带动整台机器的齿轮。

branches.en: THE PERSON: being busy and taking the first step are both doing that starts from oneself.
branches.cn: 人线：忙碌与主动出手，都是从自己开始的「做」。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCE: an ingredient or a metal that still works on other things is active.
branches.cn: 物质线：还能对其他东西起作用的成分或金属，就是活性。

branches.en: THE SERVICE: a soldier on duty is actually doing the job.
branches.cn: 服役线：正在执勤的军人真正在做这份工作。

branches.en: THE GRAMMAR: the subject that performs the action is the active subject.
branches.cn: 语法线：自己做动作的主语就是主动的主语。

branches.en: THE LIVING SYSTEMS: a volcano and an account are active while they can still do something.
branches.cn: 活动系统线：火山与账户在还能「做」点什么的时候，就是 active 的。
