senses.title: Something that people do
senses.definition: a particular thing that people do, especially for interest, pleasure or a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 人们所做的某件具体的事，尤指出于兴趣、娱乐或某种目的
senses.example: The camp offers a different outdoor activity every afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 这个夏令营每天下午都安排一项不同的户外活动。
senses.why: Late Latin activitas named the quality of doing; a bounded piece of doing becomes a countable activity.
senses.whyCN: 晚期拉丁语 activitas 指「做的性质」；一段有边界的「做」就成了可数的 activity。

senses.title: The state of being busy
senses.definition: the state of being busy, or the amount of movement and work going on
senses.definitionCN: 忙碌的状态，或正在发生的动作与工作的总量
senses.example: The market is full of activity before the new year.
senses.exampleCN: 新年前的市场一片繁忙。
senses.why: The same noun can name a state rather than an event: where much is being done, there is activity.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词也可以指一种状态而不是一件事：做得多的场所就有 activity。

senses.title: Physical movement using energy
senses.definition: bodily movement that uses energy, such as walking, running or lifting
senses.definitionCN: 消耗能量的身体运动，如行走、奔跑或举重
senses.example: Doctors recommend thirty minutes of physical activity a day.
senses.exampleCN: 医生建议每天进行三十分钟的身体活动。
senses.why: The body doing something is the most concrete kind of activity, measured in minutes and breaths.
senses.whyCN: 身体在做事情，是 activity 最具体的一种，可以用分钟和呼吸来计量。

senses.title: Business and economic operations
senses.definition: the business or economic operations of a region, market or company
senses.definitionCN: 某地区、市场或公司的商业或经济活动
senses.example: Tourism is the main economic activity on the island.
senses.exampleCN: 旅游业是这座岛上的主要经济活动。
senses.why: Money-making is doing too; economists group all such doing under economic activity.
senses.whyCN: 赚钱也是一种「做」；经济学家把所有这类「做」统称为经济活动。

senses.title: A school or club pursuit
senses.definition: an organized pursuit outside lessons, such as a sport, club or society at a school
senses.definitionCN: 课程之外有组织的活动，如学校的运动、社团或协会
senses.example: She lists drama club as her favourite activity.
senses.exampleCN: 她把戏剧社列为最喜欢的活动。
senses.why: A school day is divided into lessons and other doings; the others are simply activities.
senses.whyCN: 一天的学习被分成课业与别的「做」；那些别的「做」就叫活动。

senses.title: The strength of a substance's effect
senses.definition: the strength of a substance's effect, especially in chemistry or biology
senses.definitionCN: 某物质产生效果的强度，尤用于化学或生物学
senses.example: The chemical activity of the sample was measured in the lab.
senses.exampleCN: 样品的化学活性在实验室中被测定。
senses.why: A substance that can act strongly has high activity; the word measures doing, not motion.
senses.whyCN: 能强烈起作用的物质就有高活性；这个词量的是「起作用」，而不是运动。

senses.title: An organized event held by a group
senses.definition: an event or programme organized by an institution, group or community
senses.definitionCN: 由机构、团体或社区组织的活动或项目
senses.example: The library runs a reading activity for children each Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆每周六都为孩子们举办一项阅读活动。
senses.why: When many people do something together on a plan, the doing becomes an event with a name.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人按计划一起做一件事，这次「做」就变成了有名称的事件。

senses.title: Activity level: how active something is
senses.definition: in the phrase activity level, the amount of activity in a place, body or system
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 activity level，指某地、某身体或某系统中的活动量
senses.example: The nurses recorded the patient's activity level every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 护士每小时记录一次病人的活动量。
senses.why: Activity can be measured as a level, which turns doing into a quantity that rises or falls.
senses.whyCN: activity 可以被量成一个「水平」，于是「做」变成了可升可降的数量。

intro.en: Activity is a Late Latin noun of doing, built on activus and carried into English through French.
intro.cn: activity 是晚期拉丁语中表示「做」的名词，建立在 activus 上，经由法语进入英语。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive or perform, and it is the deepest recorded layer of the family.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、演出」，是这个词族有记录的最深一层。

items.en: activus meant practical or busy, describing a life of action rather than of thought.
items.cn: activus 意为「实践的、忙碌的」，用来形容行动的生活而非沉思的生活。

items.en: activitas named the quality or state of being active, a noun built on the adjective.
items.cn: activitas 指「活跃的性质或状态」，是在形容词基础上构成的名词。

items.en: French activité carried the noun into English, where it first meant a state rather than a single event.
items.cn: 法语 activité 把这个名词带入英语，最初指的是状态，而不是某一件具体的事。

items.en: The countable sense of a single pursuit grew later, and the scientific sense of activity developed in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 「一项具体活动」的可数义较晚才发展出来，科学上的「活性」义则在十九世纪形成。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same active family; the near-meaning group gathers words for pursuits, movement and operations.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 active 词族；近义组收表示事务、运动与运作的词。

entries.definition: The doing itself, or its effect; a close relative with a more forceful tone.

entries.definition: A person who performs or acts; the one who carries out an activity.

entries.definition: To set something going; formed from active plus -ate.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使启动、激活」，由 active 加 -ate 构成。

entries.definition: An activity someone spends time on, especially for pleasure; often formal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「爱好、事务」，指某人投入时间的活动，常带正式色彩。

entries.definition: Physical activity done to stay healthy, or a task done for practice.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「锻炼、练习」，指为健康做的身体活动或为熟练做的功课。

entries.definition: The working of a system, machine or business; doing viewed as functioning.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运转、经营」，把「做」看作系统或业务的运作。

entries.definition: Something done for enjoyment in free time; lighter than activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「消遣、娱乐」，指空闲时为乐趣做的事，比 activity 更轻。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Late Latin activitas root and the phrases activity actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的晚期拉丁语 activitas 词根，以及 activity 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: activitas is the state of doing: activity is doing turned into a noun.
normal.cn: activitas 是「做的状态」：activity 就是把「做」变成名词。

normal.en: Active, action and actor all sit behind this longer noun.
normal.cn: active、action 与 actor 都站在这个更长的名词背后。

normal.en: Physical activity is measured in minutes of movement.
normal.cn: physical activity 是用运动分钟数来衡量的。

normal.en: Economic activity is the sum of buying, selling and producing.
normal.cn: economic activity 是买卖与生产的总和。

normal.en: An activity level is a number that rises when more is being done.
normal.cn: activity level 是一个数字，做得越多它就越高。

abstract.en: Picture a playground where every group is moving at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一片操场，每一群人都同时动了起来。

abstract.en: One group runs, one builds, one sells cakes: all of it is activity.
abstract.cn: 一群人在跑，一群人在搭东西，一群人在卖蛋糕：全都是 activity。

abstract.en: Activity is the visible sum of many small doings in one place.
abstract.cn: activity 就是同一处许多小的「做」加起来的可见总和。

examples.en: The school offers many after-class activities.
examples.cn: 这所学校提供许多课外活动。

examples.en: Regular physical activity is good for the heart.
examples.cn: 经常进行身体活动对心脏有益。

examples.en: The town becomes quiet when farming activity stops.
examples.cn: 农事活动一停，镇上就安静下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克提维提」——人一活动，场面就热起来：活动、活力

root: 晚期拉丁语 activitas「活跃、活动」由 activus 加 -itas 构成，而 activus 又出自 agere「做、驱动」，可追溯到原始印欧语 *ag-「驱赶、推动」。英语经由法语 activité 借入，先指状态，后指具体活动。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of activity all count doing: one pursuit, a busy state, body movement, business, school clubs, chemical strength, an organized event, and a measured level.
sensesIntro.cn: activity 的八个义项都在给「做」计量：一项事务、一种繁忙状态、身体运动、经济活动、学校社团、化学活性、组织举办的活动，以及被量化的活跃程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: groups of people move at the same time on one open ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：一群群人在同一片空地上同时动起来。

branches.en: THE EVENT: a bounded piece of doing becomes an activity, and a planned one becomes an organized event.
branches.cn: 事件线：一段有边界的「做」成为一项活动，按计划举办的则成为组织活动。

branches.en: THE STATE: where much is being done, the place itself is full of activity.
branches.cn: 状态线：做得多的场所本身就充满 activity。

branches.en: THE BODY: movement that burns energy is the most concrete activity.
branches.cn: 身体线：消耗能量的运动是最具体的 activity。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION: markets and schools each organize their own kinds of doing.
branches.cn: 机构线：市场与学校各自组织属于自己的那类「做」。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: chemical strength and activity level turn doing into a quantity.
branches.cn: 度量线：化学活性与活动量把「做」变成可测的数量。

intro.en: Activity adds the Latin quality suffix -itas to activus; English later keeps the whole Latin shape.
intro.cn: activity 在 activus 上加了拉丁语表性质的 -itas；英语后来沿用了整个拉丁形态。

latinIntro.en: Latin activus and Late Latin activitas are both recorded, so only the deeper root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 activus 与晚期拉丁语 activitas 均有记录，只有更深的词根属于重构。

items.example: The verb is the deepest recorded layer.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是有记录的最深一层。
它提供形容词基础。

items.example: The Latin noun is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是直接来源。
它把 active 变成 activity。
它构成 active。
它构成 activate。
它构成 activist。
它构成 inactivity。

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ity 得到，义为「活跃的；主动的」
由 active 加 -ate 构成，义为「使启动；激活」
由 active 加 -ly 构成，义为「积极地；活跃地」
由 in- 加本词构成，义为「不活动；静止」

definition_zh: 男演员；演员；行动者；参与者
definition_en: a person who performs in plays or films, or a person or group that acts in a situation
core_image: 台上一个人披着别人的外衣，说出别人的台词
scene: 幕布升起前，后台只亮着一盏小灯，有人对着镜子反复念白。The young actor forgot his lines on the first night.
sceneCN: 这里 actor 是「男演员」（第 1 个义项：在戏剧或影视中表演的男子）；句意为这位年轻男演员在首演之夜忘了台词。

pos.zh: 名词：男演员；演员；行动者；参与方

derivatives.zh: 由 actor 加阴性后缀 -ess 构成，义为「女演员」，语义从「演员」偏移为「女性演员」
由 actor 加形容词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「演员做派的」，语义从「演员」偏移为「像演员的」
由 actor 与 manager 复合，义为「兼做经理的演员」

senses.title: A man who performs on stage or screen
senses.definition: a person, especially a man, who performs in plays, films or shows
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧、电影或演出中表演的人，尤指男子
senses.example: The young actor forgot his lines on the first night.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻男演员在首演之夜忘了台词。
senses.why: Latin actor is simply a doer; the stage meaning is the doer who performs someone else's deeds.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 actor 本义就是「做的人」；舞台上的那一义，就是做出别人举动的那个「做者」。

senses.title: A performer on the stage
senses.definition: someone who acts in a theatre before a live audience
senses.definitionCN: 在剧场里当着现场观众表演的人
senses.example: The stage actor must project his voice to the back row.
senses.exampleCN: 舞台演员必须把声音送到最后一排。
senses.why: A theatre has a stage, and the doer who works there is named by the place.
senses.whyCN: 剧场有舞台，在那里「做」的人就由这个场所来命名。

senses.title: A performer in films
senses.definition: someone who acts in films or television, where the performance is recorded
senses.definitionCN: 在电影或电视中表演的人，其表演被录制下来
senses.example: The film actor spent months training for the role.
senses.exampleCN: 这位电影演员为这个角色训练了好几个月。
senses.why: A camera replaces the live audience, but the same doer performs in front of it.
senses.whyCN: 镜头取代了现场观众，但同一个「做者」依然在它面前表演。

senses.title: A performer heard but not seen
senses.definition: someone who performs with the voice only, dubbing a character or narrating
senses.definitionCN: 只用声音表演的人，为角色配音或做旁白
senses.example: The voice actor recorded the lines in a small studio.
senses.exampleCN: 这位配音演员在一间小录音室里录下了台词。
senses.why: Only one instrument is left, the voice, but the doer is still an actor.
senses.whyCN: 只剩下一件乐器——声音，但那个「做者」依旧是 actor。

senses.title: A person who acts in society
senses.definition: in social theory, a person or group that acts and has effects on others
senses.definitionCN: 社会理论中能够行动并对他人产生影响的个人或群体
senses.example: Sociologists study the actor within a network of relations.
senses.exampleCN: 社会学家研究关系网络中的行动者。
senses.why: The plain Latin sense survives in the sciences: whoever does something is an actor.
senses.whyCN: 最朴素的拉丁义在学术中保留下来：谁在「做」，谁就是 actor。

senses.title: A party in a legal or political process
senses.definition: one of the parties taking part in a negotiation, conflict or legal process
senses.definitionCN: 参与谈判、冲突或法律程序的一方
senses.example: Several actors are involved in the peace talks.
senses.exampleCN: 有多方参与了这场和平谈判。
senses.why: A negotiation is a stage with several performers; each party is an actor in it.
senses.whyCN: 谈判就像一个有多位表演者的舞台，每一方都是其中的 actor。

senses.title: The leading performer
senses.definition: the actor who plays the main role in a production
senses.definitionCN: 在一部作品中扮演主要角色的演员
senses.example: The lead actor carried most of the second act.
senses.exampleCN: 主演撑起了第二幕的大部分。
senses.why: Within the cast, one doer carries the main deeds; the lead is marked out by that weight.
senses.whyCN: 在一群演员中，有一个「做者」承担主要的行动；主演就是由这份分量标出来的。

senses.title: The profession of acting
senses.definition: the occupation or craft of performing roles, thought of as a career
senses.definitionCN: 扮演角色这一职业或技艺，作为一种谋生行当来看
senses.example: He has worked as an actor for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他做演员已经二十年了。
senses.why: A repeated doing becomes a trade; the doer becomes a professional.
senses.whyCN: 重复的「做」变成一门行当；那个「做者」也就成了职业人士。

intro.en: Actor is a Latin noun for a doer, formed from the verb agere and borrowed into English almost unchanged.
intro.cn: actor 是拉丁语中表示「做的人」的名词，由动词 agere 构成，几乎原样借入英语。

items.en: *ag- is generally reconstructed as to drive or lead, the motion behind the family.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ag- 意为「驱赶、引领」，是词族背后的运动。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive or perform, and its stem act- carries the deed.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、演出」，其词干 act- 承载「行为」义。

items.en: actor meant a doer, a driver or a performer; the -or suffix marks the person who does.
items.cn: actor 意为「做的人、驱动者、表演者」；-or 后缀标示施动的人。

items.en: Old French passed the word on to English, where it first meant a doer in general as well as a player.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词传给英语，当时它既指一般的「做者」，也指演员。

items.en: The theatrical sense became dominant by the sixteenth century; exact early dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，戏剧义成为主要义；确切的早期年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same acting family; the near-meaning group gathers words for performers and for parties that act.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「表演」词族；近义组收表示表演者与行动主体的词。

entries.definition: A woman who performs roles; formed from actor with the feminine suffix -ess.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「女演员」，由 actor 加阴性后缀 -ess 构成。

entries.definition: To do something or to perform; the verb inside the noun actor.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「行动、表演」，是 actor 内部的那个动词。

entries.definition: The art or profession of performing roles; the activity of an actor.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「表演、演技」，即演员所从事的活动。

entries.definition: The doing itself; the noun for what the actor produces.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、作用」，指演员所产生的那种「做」。

entries.definition: Anyone who performs before an audience, including singers, dancers and actors.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「表演者」，包括歌手、舞者与演员，范围比 actor 宽。

entries.definition: An old or formal word for an actor, or someone who plays a game or instrument.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员（旧称）、演奏者、参赛者」，语义较宽。

entries.definition: A formal or humorous word for an actor, from the name of an ancient Greek performer.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，义为「演员、演戏的」，语气正式或带戏谑，源自一位古希腊表演者的名字。

entries.definition: A person who takes part in an event or process; close to the social sense of actor.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「参与者」，接近 actor 中「行为主体」那一义。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin actor root and the phrases actor actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 actor 词根，以及 actor 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: agere is to do, and -or marks the doer: actor is the one who does.
normal.cn: agere 是「做」，-or 标示做的人：actor 就是那个做的人。

normal.en: The same -or suffix appears in doctor, teacher and sailor.
normal.cn: 同一个 -or 后缀也出现在 doctor、teacher 与 sailor 中。

normal.en: A voice actor works with the voice alone, without the body on screen.
normal.cn: voice actor 只用声音工作，屏幕上没有身体。

normal.en: The lead actor carries the main role, while a supporting actor holds up the rest.
normal.cn: lead actor 承担主要角色，supporting actor 则托起其余部分。

normal.en: In social theory an actor is anyone who acts, not only someone on a stage.
normal.cn: 在社会理论里，actor 指任何行动的人，而不只是舞台上的人。

abstract.en: Picture a figure on a lit stage wearing a coat that belongs to someone else.
abstract.cn: 想象灯光下舞台上一个人穿着别人的外套。

abstract.en: The same figure can stand in a film frame, a recording booth or a negotiating room.
abstract.cn: 同一个人也可以出现在画面里、录音间里，或谈判桌旁。

abstract.en: An actor is a doer who borrows another person's deeds for a while.
abstract.cn: actor 就是一个暂时借用别人举动来「做」的人。

examples.en: The actor spent months learning the local accent.
examples.cn: 这位演员花了几个月学习当地口音。

examples.en: Every actor in the cast received a new script.
examples.cn: 剧组的每位演员都拿到了一份新剧本。

examples.en: Researchers treat the firm as an actor in the market.
examples.cn: 研究者把这家公司视为市场中的一个行动主体。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克特」——台上一站，做别人：男演员、行动者

root: 拉丁语 actor「做的人、表演者」由 agere「做、驱动」加施动后缀 -or 构成，出自原始印欧语 *ag-「驱赶、推动」。同一后缀还见于 doctor、sailor 等词；actor 先指一般的「做者」，后以戏剧义为主。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of actor all name one doer: a man performing, a stage player, a film player, a voice, a social agent, a party, a lead, and the trade itself.
sensesIntro.cn: actor 的八个义项都在命名同一个「做者」：表演的男子、舞台演员、电影演员、配音者、社会行动者、参与方、主演，以及这门职业本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure on a lit stage wearing someone else's coat.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯光下舞台上一个人穿着别人的外套。

branches.en: THE DOER: Latin actor is simply one who does, and the stage is its first English home.
branches.cn: 做者线：拉丁语 actor 本义就是「做的人」，舞台是它在英语中的第一个家。

branches.en: THE MEDIUM: stage, film and voice are three places where the same role is performed.
branches.cn: 媒介线：舞台、电影与声音，是同一个角色被表演的三种场所。

branches.en: THE AGENT: outside the theatre, any person or party that acts is an actor.
branches.cn: 主体线：走出剧场，任何行动的个人或一方都是 actor。

branches.en: THE LEAD: one doer carries the main deeds of the story.
branches.cn: 主角线：有一个「做者」承担故事中主要的行动。

branches.en: THE TRADE: repeated performing becomes a profession with a name.
branches.cn: 职业线：反复的表演变成一门有名称的职业。

intro.en: Actor is a Latin agent noun: a verb stem plus -or, the suffix for the person who does.
intro.cn: actor 是拉丁语的施动名词：动词词干加 -or，即标示「做的人」的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere and actor are recorded, so the word itself needs no reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere 与 actor 均有记录，这个词本身无需重构。

items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「做」义。

items.example: The noun is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是英语词的直接来源。
它构成 actor 与 doctor。

items.example: It appears in act, action and actor.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 act、action 与 actor 中。
它构成 actress。
它构成 acting。
它构成 actorly。
它与 actor 复合构成 actor-manager。

由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「演员做派的」
由本词与 manager 复合，义为「兼做经理的演员」

definition_zh: 女演员
definition_en: a woman who performs roles in plays, films or shows
core_image: 聚光灯下一位女子换上戏服，成了另一个人
scene: 化妆间的镜子上贴满旧照片，她坐在灯前描眉，准备登台。The actress won the prize for her role in the new play.
sceneCN: 这里 actress 是「女演员」（第 1 个义项：在戏剧或影视中表演的女子）；句意为这位女演员凭借在新剧中的角色获奖。

pos.zh: 名词：女演员

collocations.zh: 性格女演员；角色型女演员

derivatives.zh: 由 actress 去掉阴性后缀 -ess 得到基础词，义为「男演员；行动者」
由同一词根 act 加名词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「表演；演技」

senses.title: A woman who performs roles
senses.definition: a woman who performs in plays, films or shows
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧、电影或演出中表演的女子
senses.example: The actress won the prize for her role in the new play.
senses.exampleCN: 这位女演员凭借在新剧中的角色获奖。
senses.why: Actor plus the feminine suffix -ess made a word that names a woman who does another person's deeds on stage.
senses.whyCN: actor 加阴性后缀 -ess，造出一个指「在舞台上做别人举动」的女子的词。

senses.title: A woman performing on the stage
senses.definition: a woman who acts in a theatre before a live audience
senses.definitionCN: 在剧场里当着现场观众表演的女子
senses.example: The stage actress could hold the whole hall with her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这位舞台女演员能用声音镇住整个大厅。
senses.why: The oldest home of the word is the theatre, where the audience is present in the same room.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的家是剧场，那里观众与演员同处一室。

senses.title: A woman performing in films
senses.definition: a woman who acts in films or television, where the performance is recorded
senses.definitionCN: 在电影或电视中表演的女子，其表演被录制下来
senses.example: The film actress trained for six months to ride a horse.
senses.exampleCN: 这位电影女演员为骑马训练了六个月。
senses.why: The camera replaced the live audience, but the same role is still performed by a woman.
senses.whyCN: 镜头取代了现场观众，但同一个角色仍由一位女子来演。

senses.title: A woman heard but not seen
senses.definition: a woman who performs with the voice only, dubbing a character or narrating
senses.definitionCN: 只用声音表演的女子，为角色配音或做旁白
senses.example: The voice actress gave the cartoon queen a warm laugh.
senses.exampleCN: 这位配音女演员给了卡通女王一阵温暖的笑声。
senses.why: Even when the body is not shown, the voice still performs, so the performer keeps the name.
senses.whyCN: 即使身体不出镜，声音仍在表演，于是表演者仍保留这个名字。

senses.title: The leading female role
senses.definition: the actress who plays the main female role in a production
senses.definitionCN: 在一部作品中扮演主要女性角色的女演员
senses.example: The leading actress carried every scene of the second half.
senses.exampleCN: 这位女主角撑起了后半场的每一幕。
senses.why: Among the women in a cast, one carries the main deeds, and that weight marks her out.
senses.whyCN: 在一群女演员中，有一位承担主要的行动，这份分量把她区分出来。

senses.title: A woman in a smaller role
senses.definition: the actress who plays a secondary role beside the leading players
senses.definitionCN: 在主角身边扮演次要角色的女演员
senses.example: She was nominated as best supporting actress.
senses.exampleCN: 她获得了最佳女配角提名。
senses.why: A story needs many doers; the ones beside the lead are supporting actresses.
senses.whyCN: 故事需要许多「做者」；站在主角旁边的那些就是女配角。

senses.title: A woman who plays odd or vivid characters
senses.titleCN: 性格女演员；角色型女演员
senses.definition: an actress known for strong or unusual character roles rather than for a standard romantic lead
senses.definitionCN: 以鲜明或古怪的角色见长，而非以标准恋爱主角见长的女演员
senses.example: The character actress turned a tiny part into the best scene.
senses.exampleCN: 这位性格女演员把一个极小的角色演成了全场最好的一幕。
senses.why: Some performers do not play the pretty lead but a marked character; the trade names that speciality.
senses.whyCN: 有些表演者不演漂亮的主角，而演特征鲜明的角色；行当里给这种专长起了名字。

senses.title: The profession of a female performer
senses.definition: the occupation or craft of a woman who performs roles, thought of as a career
senses.definitionCN: 女性扮演角色这一职业或技艺，作为一种谋生行当来看
senses.example: She has worked as an actress since she was eighteen.
senses.exampleCN: 她从十八岁起就做女演员。
senses.why: Repeated performing hardens into a trade; the woman who does it becomes a professional.
senses.whyCN: 反复的表演固化成行当；做这件事的女子就成了职业人士。

intro.en: Actress is an English formation: the Latin agent noun actor plus the feminine suffix -ess.
intro.cn: actress 是英语中造出的词：拉丁语施动名词 actor 加阴性后缀 -ess。

items.en: actor meant a doer or a performer, formed from agere with the agent suffix -or.
items.cn: actor 意为「做的人、表演者」，由 agere 加施动后缀 -or 构成。

items.en: The feminine suffix -issa came from Greek into Late Latin, where it marked a woman in a role.
items.cn: 阴性后缀 -issa 从希腊语进入晚期拉丁语，用来标示担任某一角色的女性。

items.en: Old French reshaped the suffix as -esse, which English borrowed for its own feminine nouns.
items.cn: 古法语把这个后缀变成 -esse，英语借来用于自己的阴性名词。

items.en: actress is recorded from the late sixteenth century, when women began to appear on the English stage.
items.cn: actress 自十六世纪后期有记录，当时女性开始出现在英国舞台上。

items.en: The word is still used, though many performers now prefer actor for both sexes; the style is changing.
items.cn: 这个词仍在使用，但如今许多表演者不分性别都更愿意用 actor；用法正在变化。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same acting family; the near-meaning group gathers words for female and general performers.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「表演」词族；近义组收表示女性表演者与一般表演者的词。

entries.definition: A performer of either sex, and the word from which actress was built.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员」，可指男女，也是 actress 所由构成的基础词。

entries.definition: To perform or to do something; the verb behind the whole family.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「表演、行动」，是整个词族背后的动词。

entries.definition: The art or profession of performing roles.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「表演、演技」。

entries.definition: The doing itself; the noun for what a performer produces.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、作用」，指表演者所产生的那种「做」。

entries.definition: A person of either sex who performs before an audience; broader than actress.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「表演者」，可指男女，范围比 actress 宽。

entries.definition: An older word for an actor, or someone who plays an instrument or a game.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演员（旧称）、演奏者、参赛者」。

entries.definition: A formal word for an actor of either sex, from an ancient Greek performer's name.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，义为「演员、演戏的」，语气正式，源自一位古希腊表演者的名字。

entries.definition: The principal female performer in a production; a phrase rather than a single noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词短语，义为「女主角」，指作品中的主要女性表演者。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real actor root and the -ess suffix, plus the phrases actress appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 actor 词根与 -ess 后缀，以及 actress 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: actor is a doer, and -ess marks a woman: actress is a woman who does on stage.
normal.cn: actor 是「做的人」，-ess 标示女性：actress 就是在舞台上「做」的女子。

normal.en: The suffix -ess also appears in waitress, hostess and princess.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ess 也出现在 waitress、hostess 与 princess 中。

normal.en: A voice actress works with the voice alone, no face on screen.
normal.cn: voice actress 只用声音工作，屏幕上没有面孔。

normal.en: A character actress is known for odd or strong parts, not for the pretty lead.
normal.cn: character actress 以古怪或强烈的角色闻名，而不是以漂亮主角闻名。

normal.en: Many performers now use actor for both sexes, so actress carries a slightly older tone.
normal.cn: 如今许多表演者男女都用 actor，因此 actress 带一点较早年代的色彩。

abstract.en: Picture a woman at a mirror putting on a costume that belongs to a character.
abstract.cn: 想象一位女子在镜前穿上属于某个角色的戏服。

abstract.en: The same figure can be on a stage, in a film frame or behind a microphone.
abstract.cn: 同一位女子可以站在舞台上、出现在画面里，或坐在麦克风后。

abstract.en: Actress is a doer wearing a borrowed life for the length of a scene.
abstract.cn: actress 就是一个在一幕的时间里穿上借来人生的「做者」。

examples.en: The actress practised her accent with a coach every day.
examples.cn: 这位女演员每天跟教练练口音。

examples.en: Two actresses shared the prize for best performance.
examples.cn: 两位女演员共享了最佳表演奖。

examples.en: She became an actress after years of small stage roles.
examples.cn: 在多年演小舞台角色之后，她成了一名女演员。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克特瑞斯」——灯一亮，她成了别人：女演员

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of actress all name one woman doing: a performer, a stage player, a film player, a voice, a lead, a supporting player, a character specialist, and the trade itself.
sensesIntro.cn: actress 的八个义项都在命名同一位「做」的女子：表演者、舞台演员、电影演员、配音者、女主角、女配角、性格演员，以及这门职业本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a woman at a lit mirror puts on a costume and becomes someone else.
core.cn: 核心意象：一位女子在灯下的镜前换上戏服，成了另一个人。

branches.en: THE DOER: a woman who performs, and the same doing hardened into a profession.
branches.cn: 做者线：一位表演的女子，以及同一份「做」固化成的职业。

branches.en: THE MEDIUM: stage, film and voice are three places where she performs.
branches.cn: 媒介线：舞台、电影与声音，是她表演的三种场所。

branches.en: THE LEAD: one woman carries the main deeds of the story.
branches.cn: 主角线：有一位女子承担故事中主要的行动。

branches.en: THE SUPPORT: other women hold up the edges of the same story.
branches.cn: 配角线：其余女子托起同一个故事的边角。

branches.en: THE SPECIALITY: some women are known for vivid odd characters rather than for the lead.
branches.cn: 专长线：有些女子以鲜明古怪的角色闻名，而不是以主角闻名。

intro.en: Actress is an English noun built from a Latin agent noun plus a feminine suffix of Greek origin.
intro.cn: actress 是英语名词，由拉丁语施动名词加一个源自希腊语的阴性后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin actor and the suffix -issa are recorded; the feminine ending reached English through French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 actor 与后缀 -issa 均有记录；这个阴性词尾经由法语进入英语。

items.example: It marks a woman in a role.
items.exampleCN: 它标示担任角色的女性。

items.example: It carried the feminine ending into English.
items.exampleCN: 它把阴性词尾带入英语。

items.example: It forms actress, waitress and princess.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 actress、waitress 与 princess。

items.example: It appears in act, action and actress.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 act、action 与 actress 中。
它构成 acting。

definition_zh: 实际的；真实的；现实的；确实存在的
definition_en: real and existing in fact, rather than imagined, expected or pretended
core_image: 一张照片与它背后的实景叠在一起
scene: 账本上的数字只是估算，等到月底结算才发现差了不少。The actual cost was twice what the estimate suggested.
sceneCN: 这里 actual 是「实际成本」中的「实际的」（第 5 个义项：真正付出的数额，而非事先估算的数额）；句意为实际成本是估算值的两倍。

pos.zh: 形容词：实际的；真实的；现实的；确实存在的

derivatives.zh: 由 actual 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「实际上；竟然」，语义从「真实的」偏移为「出乎意料地确实如此」
由 actual 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「现实；实际情况」
由 actual 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「使实现；把……变为现实」
由 actualize 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「实现；现实化」

senses.title: Real, not invented
senses.definition: existing in fact and not invented, imagined or pretended
senses.definitionCN: 确实存在于事实中，而非编造、想象或假装的
senses.example: The film is based on an actual event in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影取材于村里真实发生过的一件事。
senses.why: Late Latin actualis meant of action; what has really been done is what truly exists, so actual came to mean real.
senses.whyCN: 晚期拉丁语 actualis 意为「行动的」；真正被做出来的东西才是真实存在的，因此 actual 转为「真实的」。

senses.title: Real rather than expected
senses.definition: real and measured, as opposed to estimated, planned or predicted
senses.definitionCN: 真实并可计量的，相对于估算、计划或预测而言
senses.example: The actual result was far below the forecast.
senses.exampleCN: 实际结果远低于预测。
senses.why: Plans are doings in the mind; the actual figure is the one the world has already produced.
senses.whyCN: 计划是头脑里的「做」；实际数字则是世界已经产生出来的那个。

senses.title: Existing now, current
senses.definition: existing at the present time, as opposed to what existed before or may exist later
senses.definitionCN: 在当前时间存在的，相对于过去或将来可能存在的状态
senses.example: The actual situation is calmer than the newspapers suggest.
senses.exampleCN: 现实情况比报纸上说的要平静。
senses.why: What is actual is what is in effect at this moment, not what used to be or might be.
senses.whyCN: actual 的东西就是此刻正在起作用的东西，而不是过去的或将来的。

senses.title: Truly existing, not merely named
senses.definition: having real existence, as opposed to being only a name, a picture or an idea
senses.definitionCN: 具有真实的存在，而不是只有一个名称、图像或念头
senses.example: We need the actual documents, not copies of them.
senses.exampleCN: 我们要的是那些文件本身，而不是它们的副本。
senses.why: Between a word and the thing there is a gap; actual closes it by pointing to the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 词与物之间有一道缝；actual 指向物本身，就把这道缝合上了。

senses.title: The real amount paid: actual cost
senses.definition: in the phrase actual cost, the real amount paid for something, as opposed to an estimate
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 actual cost，指为某物真正付出的金额，相对于估算额
senses.example: The actual cost was twice what the estimate suggested.
senses.exampleCN: 实际成本是估算值的两倍。
senses.why: Accounting needs the figure that left the account, not the figure that was hoped for.
senses.whyCN: 会计要的是真正从账上划走的数字，而不是当初希望的那个数字。

senses.title: The present condition: actual state
senses.definition: in the phrase actual state, the condition something is really in at present
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 actual state，指某物目前真正所处的状态
senses.example: A survey described the actual state of the old bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 一份勘察报告描述了这座旧桥的实际状况。
senses.why: Before repair there must be a record of what is truly there, and that record is the actual state.
senses.whyCN: 修缮之前必须先记下真正存在的东西，这份记录就是现状。

senses.title: Real possession in law
senses.definition: in law, real and physical possession of property, as opposed to a mere right to it
senses.definitionCN: 法律上对财产的真实、实际的占有，相对于仅仅拥有权利
senses.example: The court asked who had actual possession of the land.
senses.exampleCN: 法院询问谁对该土地拥有实际占有。
senses.why: A right on paper and a hand on the gate are different; the law names the second actual possession.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的权利与放在门上的手并不相同；法律把后一种称为实际占有。

senses.title: An emphatic really, in speech
senses.definition: in informal speech, used to emphasize that something is surprisingly true
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来强调某事竟然真的如此，带有出乎意料的语气
senses.example: He actually apologized, which nobody expected.
senses.exampleCN: 他竟然道歉了，谁也没料到。
senses.why: The word for what is real drifts into a marker of surprise: this really did happen.
senses.whyCN: 表示「真实」的词滑向表示惊讶的标记：这事竟然真的发生了。

intro.en: Actual began as a Latin adjective of action and only later shifted to mean real.
intro.cn: actual 最初是拉丁语中表示「行动的」形容词，后来才转为「真实的」。

items.en: agere meant to do or drive, and its participle stem act- carries the sense of what has been done.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动」，其分词词干 act- 承载「已经做出」的意思。

items.en: actus named a doing or a driving, and it supplied the noun base for the adjective.
items.cn: actus 指「行为、驱动」，为这个形容词提供名词基础。

items.en: actualis meant of action, practical or active, not yet real in the modern sense.
items.cn: actualis 意为「行动的、实践的、活跃的」，当时还没有现代「真实」的意思。

items.en: Old French actuel carried the word into English with the sense of active or practical.
items.cn: 古法语 actuel 把这个词带入英语，当时意为「活跃的、实践的」。

items.en: The sense shifted from practical to real and existing, and the emphatic spoken use grew much later; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 词义从「实践的」转为「真实的、确实存在的」，口语中的强调用法则晚得多才出现；确切年代不确定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same acting family; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for what truly exists.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「行动」词族；近义组收表示「真正存在」的形容词。

entries.definition: To do something, or a deed; the verb and noun behind actual.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，义为「行动、行为」，是 actual 背后的动词与名词。

entries.definition: The doing itself, from the same Latin noun actio.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动、作用」，出自同一拉丁名词 actio。

entries.definition: The state of being real; formed from actual plus -ity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「现实、实际情况」，由 actual 加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: In fact, or surprisingly; formed from actual plus -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「实际上、竟然」，由 actual 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: To make a law or perform a scene; the same root with the prefix en-.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「制定法律、演出」，同一词根加前缀 en-。

entries.definition: Existing in fact, not imagined; the most general word for what actual adds emphasis to.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「真实的、真正的」，是最一般的说法，actual 常用来加强它。

entries.definition: Truly what it is claimed to be, not false or copied; stresses authenticity.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「真正的、非伪造的」，强调货真价实。

entries.definition: Based on facts and containing no invention; used of accounts and reports.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「基于事实的」，用于叙述与报告，强调不含编造。

entries.definition: Specific and definite rather than general or abstract; able to be pointed at.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「具体的」，与笼统抽象相对，指可以指着说的东西。

entries.definition: Happening or existing now; overlaps with the present-time sense of actual.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「当前的、现行的」，与 actual 中「现实的」那一义重叠。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin actualis root and the phrases actual actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语 actualis 词根，以及 actual 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: actus is a doing: actual first meant of action, then of what has really been done.
normal.cn: actus 是「行为」：actual 先指「行动的」，再指「真正做成的」。

normal.en: The same root gives act, action and actor, all about doing.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 act、action 与 actor，都与「做」有关。

normal.en: Actual cost is the money that really left the account.
normal.cn: actual cost 是真正从账上划走的钱。

normal.en: In actual fact is a fixed phrase that insists on the real state of things.
normal.cn: in actual fact 是坚持「事情真实状况」的固定说法。

normal.en: Actually often means surprisingly, not merely in reality.
normal.cn: actually 常表示「竟然」，而不只是「实际上」。

abstract.en: Picture a photograph laid over the place it shows, line for line.
abstract.cn: 想象一张照片严丝合缝地盖在它所拍摄的实景上。

abstract.en: Where the two images match, you have the actual thing; where they differ, you have the estimate.
abstract.cn: 两张影像重合的地方就是实际之物；错开的地方就是估算。

abstract.en: Actual always points away from the copy and towards the thing itself.
abstract.cn: actual 总是从副本指向物本身。

examples.en: The actual cost of the repair was much higher.
examples.cn: 这次修理的实际成本高得多。

examples.en: The book is based on actual letters from the war.
examples.cn: 这本书取材于战争期间真实的信件。

examples.en: She actually finished the whole report in one night.
examples.cn: 她竟然一夜之间把整份报告写完了。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a photograph laid exactly over the place it shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张照片严丝合缝地盖在它所拍的实景上。

branches.en: THE THING: what has really been done exists, and actual points at the thing itself.
branches.cn: 实物线：真正做出来的东西是存在的，actual 指向物本身。

branches.en: THE FIGURE: measured results and real costs replace estimates and hopes.
branches.cn: 数字线：量出的结果与真实成本取代了估算与期望。

branches.en: THE PRESENT: the situation now, and the state a survey records before repair.
branches.cn: 当下线：此刻的情形，以及修缮前勘察记录下来的状态。

branches.en: THE LAW: a right on paper differs from a hand actually on the gate.
branches.cn: 法律线：纸上的权利不同于真正放在门上的那只手。
